Planet.name: Murkhana
Planet.description: This world was a tourist attraction for the beauty of its oceans, black beaches, sheltered coves and coral reefs. The forests and plains are a constant bright but murky green. The inhabitants have sided with the CIS and is a hosting planet for CIS propaganda.

Planet.name: Nyriaan
Planet.description: Nyriaan is a unique planet within the galaxy. It is covered in a thick cloud layer above its atmosphere that is so strong it blocks all communication to and from the surface, as well as making unaided landing impossible. Furthermore, the weather on Nyriaan poses a constraint threat to its inhabitants and further makes landings upon the planet beyond dangerous. Storms on the planet can be massive and quite common, lasting months on end. Interestingly, another phenomenon on Nyriaan is its interaction with the Force. While force sensitives could use the Force while on its surface, they couldn’t do so while in planetary atmosphere, due to a currently unidentified interference. The planet's surface consists of plains and low hills, with some valleys, where boggy conditions have formed. In the northern hemisphere, there are many shallow, rocky valleys, which were where most of the planet's mining operations had once taken place before mysteriously being abandoned. Lastly, and most interestingly, there have been rumors and folk stories being told about strange individuals roaming the surface of Nyriaan’s northern hemisphere. Helmeted monstrosities dragging settlers away into the night. Such folk stories have been told for the last couple of thousand years and have mostly been ignored by Republic officials.

Planet.name: Silla
Planet.description: The peaceful planet of Silla is inhabited by small villages. They are often found in the vast forests or on the side of large mountains. The temperate world is quiet.

Planet.name: Agaris
Planet.description: Agaris is a planet with an extremely damp and clammy climate like that of a jungle without any trees.

Planet.name: Csilla
Planet.description: Csilla is a planet forever locked in ice. There is nothing on the surface other than military complexes and fake cities. Most of the fauna that existed on the planet no longer exist save a few trees that can be found in caves.

Planet.name: Benath
Planet.description: The rocky planet of Benath is located in Wild Space. The Benathy created their cities using the rocks and foliage among the orange surface. It is home to a monarchy civilization that is not affiliated with the Republic or the CIS.

Planet.name: Malden
Planet.description: Unknown

Planet.name: Keitum
Planet.description: A planet of varying hot and warm climates. Most of the planet is covered in plains and rivers. Due to the tilt of the planet the deserts that exist are located on the north pole and the only bit of snow on the south pole.

Planet.name: Harvest
Planet.description: A once beautiful planet rich with rare minerals now devastated to almost all desert due to a nuclear reaction going off from a poorly maintained reactor. The inhabitants now live as nomads in the wilderness or in the old mining cities that were left over from the original mining company that controlled the planet. The cities are lucky enough to be surrounded by the last remaining plains. Now the cities have coliseums for gladiator fights so that the wealthy can stay in power.

Planet.name: Endovar
Planet.description: A world that hosts a jedi temple. The surroundings are unknown to keep the location secret. Otherwise the planet is a jungle planet with spikey mountains poking out of the foliage.

Planet.name: Kakra
Planet.description: This is an unstable volcanic planet. Inhabitable and destructive in nature. The land is ever changing with the constantly active volcanoes.

Planet.name: Ring of Kafrene
Planet.description: The mining complex of the Ring of Kafrene is known to many as a hub for trade along the Thrand Sector. The structure connected planetoids together which attracted many wandering travelers as well as a resting spot for known bounty hunters or secret informants.

Planet.name: Guagenia
Planet.description: Guagenia is a barren planet with little vegetation. With towering sand dunes the planet is not populated and there is a lack of water to be found on the planet’s surface. The sand, however, is also mixed in with spice, a mind altering substance. Survivable conditions can be found deep within caves with sources of water and cooler temperatures than above ground.

Planet.name: Throffdon
Planet.description: Throffdon is a planet in the Inner Rim as well as “The Interior” territories, Grid Square J-9, with no hyperspace routes attached. Throffdon is a very unique planet in that it orbits an octonary, eight, star cluster. This means that Throffdon never has a documented night, as day lasts year round for the planet. A “night” may be possible only when all eight stars are on the opposite side of the planet but even then the night would not cover the whole planet. As such Throffdon has no atmosphere and is uninhabitable to any forms of life aside from some extremophile lifeforms, like the Midi-chlorian.

Planet.name: Boiyuh
Planet.description: Boiyuh is a planet in the Colonies and “The Interior” regions of the galaxy, Grid Square J-9, with no attached hyperspace lanes. Boiyuh is a planet with an atmosphere and natural water. Boiyeah is covered heavily in trees and lakes. Notably quite a peaceful planet that was until the discovery of the hallucinogen “Veil” Boiyuh quickly became known for its parties across the galaxy. Oftentimes parties would go on for months. While seen now as something bad, these parties had a notable social benefit, species from all walks of life gathered together to have fun, the rich, the poor, the powerful and the weak all gathered around the same fires. The expression “Boiyuh” widespread throughout the galaxy originates from the planet, it means a form of excitement or accomplishment.

Planet.name: Gwongdeen
Planet.description: Covered completely in a living sea of membranous biological matter which is dark red and pink in color. Underneath that sea is a rocky surface with a singular spaceport. In order to reach the true surface force fields are used to push the sea water out of the way for ships to pass through.

Planet.name: Galagolos
Planet.description: Galagolos is a smaller planet of mostly swamps. Due to the swamps and the humidity, the planet has an awful stench that permeates everything, even through filters.

Planet.name: Quarzite
Planet.description: Quarzite is an unassuming planet of grey and violet everywhere. Though the atmosphere is so thick it causes a constant storm of lightning and heavy rain, making reaching the surface almost impossible. The only way down is through one massive turbolift. Underground, there are grand caves with a breathable atmosphere. In the caves are bright violet crystals and crystalline structures that shine brightly enough to see without the star that Quarzite orbits.

Planet.name: Borosk
Planet.description: Borosk is a normal planet, but due to many invasions has become a fortress world with an exterior shield and hundreds of fortifications planet side. It has a very rocky surface with differing weather.

Planet.name: Dinwa Prime
Planet.description: Unknown

Planet.name: Bimmisaari
Planet.description: A mostly dense jungle planet with normal forests and plains. The near-humanoids that live here build their sky scraping cities amongst the few plains that exist on their planet.

high_value_targets.name: Rogue Clone
high_value_targets.title: Clone Deserter
high_value_targets.intel: Clone deserter

Planet.name: Janix
Planet.description: A blue world with dense cities scattered across the surface. The main attraction of this planet is Janix City, which is built inside of a crater with towering sky scrapers and gangsters around every corner.

Planet.name: Kotab
Planet.description: Kotab is a warm world of jungles and deserts and the home world of the bald Kotabi. The population lives in pyramid shaped stone buildings and are loyal to their King who possesses ancient Sith artifacts now deemed just symbols of his authority.

high_value_targets.name: King Koag
high_value_targets.title: King
high_value_targets.intel: The Koabi King of Kotab the Jedi considers him tainted by Sith artifacts.

Planet.name: Rajtiri
Planet.description: An arid world of ancient buildings, colossal pavilions, and elaborate mausoleums. Rajtiri is a smuggling hub with a thriving black market. Powerful families profit from the smuggling. As part of the republic they are only proof of how corrupt it is.

Planet.name: Basthata
Planet.description: Due to the super red giant as the planet’s sun, everything on the surface is super heated and charred. As such any life that does exist lives underground in massive cave formations that were either drilled or formed by lava.

Planet.name: Tehar
Planet.description: Unknown

Planet.name: Iberius
Planet.description: Kril'dor is a barren planet due to the tibanna gas trapped underneath the surface. Large extractors and refineries are displaced around the planet, continuously polluting. The Techno Union own the factories and make an immense profit from selling around the galaxy, specifically Bespin.

Planet.name: Circumtore
Planet.description: This planetoid is in the shape of a ring. With the “planet” surface being on the inside of that ring. The Hutts have control and inhabit this ring-shaped artificial planet. It has every biome that we know of perfectly spaced throughout the ring. Its gravity is artificially made through centripetal force. The ring provides a space for life to grow on its surface to make a breathable atmosphere, but beneath is complex technology that sustains the ring.

Planet.name: Cyrillia
Planet.description: An industrialized planet solely focused upon making the DUM-series pit droid.

Planet.name: Espirion
Planet.description: A pale blue planet with only one city on it. The city was made of softly curving white buildings.

Planet.name: Erebus
Planet.description: Erebus is in the Colonies regions of the Galaxy, Grid Square N-13, with no major trade route attached. A terrestrial planet with a breathable atmosphere, it is a mountainous and muddy world, featuring lakes and canyons. As well as a persisting fog that encapsules the planet. The planet was known for its valuable resources not taken advantage of by any major faction in the Galaxy.

Planet.name: Triffis
Planet.description: Triffis is home to the sentient humanoid Triffians. Their home planet is a forest world with overgrown trees. They were some of the first to start forming advanced technology. Their short stature led them to make quick ground vehicles. Some were adapted to be pod racers.

Planet.name: Arkanis
Planet.description: Arkanis is a temperate planet with a comfortable atmosphere. It's known to be very rainy and flourishing with life. As well as large mountain ranges and deep seas. The settlements are very industrialized due to the Techno Union's influence on the planet. Military complexes and orbital defense platforms sprawl the planet's urban areas.

Planet.name: Savareen
Planet.description: Savareen is a world of sandy dunes and massive oceans, with the vocational ramshackle town made of scrap parts from various ships. It is host to the infamous Crimson Dawn mercenary group who will fight for the highest bidder but will also attack anyone not willing to pay them. The world also serves as a smuggling hub with a thriving black market willing to engage in many forbidden trades. Most of its inhabitants are wanted in the Republic.

Planet.name: Sevarcos II
Planet.description: This planet was the only inhabitable planet in the Severcos System, and the only source for the Spice variants, Carsunum and Andris. At the time jedi Master Dooku was responsible for the resolution of the Sevarcos Dispute. The planet is conquered by vast plains in brown and amber shades with a dry and rugged temperature. The northern hemisphere was mountainous and jagged, the center belt of the planet was vast plains, and the south was dominated by harsh winds and sandstorms that shaped the terrain. The planet gained the nickname of “The World of Endless Wind” due to the gale force around certain annual equinoxes. Comparatively to Tatooine, the planet was measurably hot during the day, and cool at night. Underground was a haven of sorts rich with networks of rivers, lakes and pools which made for loads of flora and fauna to prosper, to include burrowing sandworms named spice eels. The planet was also home to spice mining, slavery, and six star ports. The Separatists hold two of these Star ports, and the rest are dominated by the spice slavers of the Sevari Society. Hundreds of spice mines dotted the planet using slave labor to feed and fund the main and only exportable goods of the planet.

Planet.name: Kabal
Planet.description: The Trade Federation abandoned the planet of Kabal and its entire Trade Corridor in protest of Galactic Republic taxation, so the planet fell into deep food shortage riots. The Separatist, using this for momentum, seized the opportunity to win the planet over to their allegiance by air dropping in food supplies. A massive riot broke out and four Jedi were killed, as well as Premiere Jan Dovu, the Planet’s leader. The planet itself features lots of quiet, coastal finishing towns, large forested islands, and an array of aquatic life. The Capital city of Shoribus is home to the Kabal Central Citadel, which is where the four Jedi were killed in the riots of 22 BBY.

Planet.name: Kooriva
Planet.description: An orange tropical world and current home world of the Koorivar. It is a key world of the Corporate Alliance and CIS as such it is host to large corporate compounds. It is also home to Magistrate Passel Argente who lives in the largest compound in the world and known to host a variety of exotic plants from across the Galaxy in his garden.

high_value_targets.name: Magistrate Passel Argente
high_value_targets.title: Koorivar leader of Corporate Alliance
high_value_targets.intel: One the most important members of the CIS and has an appropriate body guard for someone of his status. He lives in the largest and most fortified corporate compound in the world.

Planet.name: Farstine
Planet.description: Farstine is a world loyal to the Republic, with a methane atmosphere that requires all locals to wear gas masks. Other than its toxic atmosphere, it is a bleak temperate world with mountains, plains, and oceans. Farstine is also home to many grey, metallic industrial cities and spaceports. Every settlement consists of interconnected, sealed buildings designed to keep out the hostile atmosphere.

high_value_targets.name: Marath Vooro
high_value_targets.title: Nemodian Customs Vizier
high_value_targets.intel: Unlike most members of the trade federation he prefers hit and run tactics. He excels at raids and guerrilla warfare.

Planet.name: Inusagi
Planet.description: The planet Inusagi’s natural beauty reflected itself upon the peoples’ traditional values and wealth. The lush forests and sparkling rivers that formed into brilliant lakes all played a part in the culture of the people on Inusagi representing their nobility. As the planet lies next to wealthy planets, like Naboo, its economy was able to thrive through exports within the protected trade routes of the Republic.

Planet.name: Socorro
Planet.description: Socorro is a mostly human occupied hot arid planet with black sandy deserts, some volcanoes, and the occasional city. It is a smuggling hub with a thriving black market, and home to many nomadic tribes. It also hosts a remote Jedi Academy that trains Jedi Guardians making it vital to the Jedi.

Planet.name: Orto Plutonia
Planet.description: A snowy desolate world that the nearby Pantorans lay claim to. As such it is host to a Republic outpost to deter any CIS presence although it might be angering the local primitives instead.

Planet.name: Pantora
Planet.description: Pantora is an arid and marshy world characterized by its cities with colorful doomed buildings. The world is a loyal member of the republic but is under constant threat from the Separatists who had tried every dirty trick to get them to join the CIS.

high_value_targets.name: Baron Notluwiski Papanoida
high_value_targets.title: Pantoran Chairman
high_value_targets.intel: He has constantly been threatened by the CIS in an effort to blackmail him into joining the CIS. We can not let him get into their hands.

Planet.name: Yerbana
Planet.description: The terrestrial body consisted of mountains, oceans, vegetation and deep canyons. The diverse ecosystem allowed for life to thrive on Yerbana. Plus, it was on the Correlian Run trade route allowing for its economy to prosper. Their cities often were placed in high elevations allowing their towers to pierce permanent clouds.

Planet.name: Rugosa
Planet.description: A temperate moon that used to be a vast ocean, now dried up leaving the surface covered in large forests of coral and rocky cavernous areas. Home to King Katuunko of the Toydarian People. The Toydarians are unsure what side to join in the Clone War at this time. Young Neebray also use this moon as a nursery before embarking on a long migration across space.

high_value_targets.name: T Series Tactical Droid
high_value_targets.title: Tactical Lead
high_value_targets.intel: Controlling a droid element on the ground.

high_value_targets.name: B-1 Droid Commander
high_value_targets.title: Commander
high_value_targets.intel: Commanding droid on the ground.

Planet.name: Marleyvane
Planet.description: A forest asteroid too small to be called a planet. This rock hosts a shipyard. It hosts diverse alien fauna as well as long winding rivers. The wildlife of this planet is very docile and its land is very fertile for agriculture.

Planet.name: Baroonda
Planet.description: A planet of gorgeous beach lines and mild forests. Waterfalls and palm trees line every beach. Baroonda is known for its podracing tracks.

Planet.name: Toshara
Planet.description: Toshara is a wind swept arid planet. The strong winds have eroded most of the landscape features, making it mostly flat. There are also massive canyons with an amber-like substance called amberine that flows like lava.

Planet.name: Boonta
Planet.description: A devastated desert world of nothing but dust. In orbit there is a scarp yard for spaceships to be repaired. Here the Hutts started their famous pod-racing.

Planet.name: Chad
Planet.description: Chad’s humid and dense forest that surrounds the planet is home to the sentient species Chadra-Fans. The trees of Chad are thick and hold deep roots within the moist soil proving their long age.

Planet.name: Klatooine
Planet.description: An arid desert planet with many Hutt buildings. The planet also has a fissure named “Fountain of the Ancients” by the locals and no technology is allowed near it.

Planet.name: Sleheyron
Planet.description: A planet based on slave trade and the refineminet of tibanna gas, it was one of the most powerful economically of the Hutt worlds. A volcanic world littered with spaceports, refinery districts, industrial areas and countless urban areas and very little flora/fauna. Sleheyron as far as its economy went was second only to Nar Shaddaa.

Planet.name: Oba Diah
Planet.description: A jagged rocky planet with crystals everywhere. This planet is overcast, but never rainy. Oba Diah is the homeworld of the Pyke Syndicate and has many of the Syndicate’s hideouts and fortresses.

Planet.name: Eadu
Planet.description: As if it was caught in a neverending maelstrom, Eadu is a mountainous planet in the Outer Rim. An isolated planet in the far reaches of the galaxy where there aren’t any suspicious onlookers.

Planet.name: Ord Radama
Planet.description: Ord Radama is a heavily defended Separatist Stronghold. Ord Radama was a planet in the Radama Void of the Outer Rim Territories' Esstran sector. Once a world of marshes and wetlands, it was built up with cities and streets over the years. The planet was the home world of the Devlikk species.

Planet.name: Raydonia
Planet.description: An often overlooked, temperate, small forested planet. Sites of several small unallied settlements are here, all needing constant shipments from regularly scheduled transport ships for supplies. The planet is similar to Felucia in which it is large, colorful, and overgrown with flora and fauna.

Planet.name: Yalbeck Prime
Planet.description: Home to the Yalbec which is a bee-like creature. Little to none is known about the rest of this planet.

Planet.name: Quell
Planet.description: A non-descript blue-hazy planet with brown dirt and round bulging stones scattered across the flat plains.

Planet.name: Daro
Planet.description: The planet's surface was covered in vast verdant forests and jungles of pine trees, ferns, and other plants, which were home to carrier butterflies and massiffs. The thousands of trees engulfed Daro's landscape, which was peppered with towering rocky mountains and buttes, the cliffs of which were in turn enveloped by the trees' expansive roots. The planet featured snow-covered portions at its topmost regions as well as numerous bodies of water of variable sizes that were scattered throughout the forested areas.

Planet.name: Agamar
Planet.description: Agamar is a solitary rocky planet. Used often as a staging ground for military purposes or hiding spots for smugglers. However, farmers continue to succeed in production despite the cold climate.

Planet.name: Zeffo
Planet.description: Small settlements were often attacked by electromagnetic winds on Zeffo. The world is rich with water and a sustained ecosystem. Rocky edges scattered Zeffo’s surface with buildings often being built into the surface.

Planet.name: Pabu
Planet.description: A tiny planet that most ignore. The majority of the planet is bright blue oceans. Though there are many tiny islands scattered around the planet with small settlements on some of them. One of such settlements is a place of refuge for those who have been displaced.

Planet.name: Ajan Kloss
Planet.description: This planet is a moon to a massive gas giant. The gas giant shades the planet and its own moons from the radiation of their star. The planet is covered with one massive forest with random clearings from a civilization that once inhabited the planet. In certain areas the forest is perched upon massive cliffs. The weather is very moist which is a problem for electronics and brings on fungal infections very easily.

Planet.name: Kaller
Planet.description: Kaller is a temperate world characterized by its red snow capped mountains, lakes, and pine forests. The local Kallerians either live in primitive stone villages or urban modern mountain top cities. The dense nature gives the planet a blushing ecosystem. An important planet surrounded by Banking Clan owned systems.

Planet.name: Scipio
Planet.description: Scipio is a major Banking Clan planet and is host to their Vaults, and is used by the Banking clan as a vacationing spot. Scipio is characterized by snowy mountains with the Banking clan making modern mountainside villas for pleasure or massive Vault Cities on long tentacle-like stilts. Wealthy elites live atop lush homes as large trade deals are made here. Money speaks more than people on Scipio.

Planet.name: Ferrix
Planet.description: The people of Ferrix lived in tightly built communities and cities around Starships that were parked and being scrapped. The planet was also teeming with Corporate ran subsectors, mostly as leftovers as the sector that Ferrix is located in, used to be entirely Corporate ran before joining the Republic. This planet's position between multiple important Hyperspace Lanes makes it a crucial staging area for any mass deployments further down those lanes.

Planet.name: Lola Sayu
Planet.description: Lola Sayu is a half destroyed world full of lava and steep cliffs. It is the location of the Citadel, a heavily fortified top security prison.

high_value_targets.name: Osi Sobeck
high_value_targets.title: Separatist Commandant
high_value_targets.intel: He is a Phindian who manages the Citadel and all CIS defences on world. He is responsible for torturing multiple Republic personnel as such we plan to give him a taste of his own medicine and find what intel has been leaked.

high_value_targets.name: Wilhuff Tarkin
high_value_targets.title: Republic Admiral
high_value_targets.intel: He is a human republic Admiral who is to be rescued by special order of the Chancellor himself. Therefore refusal to make him a priority can be considered treason, failure is not an option.

Planet.name: Jabiim
Planet.description: Jabiim to a majority of the galaxy is a hellhole, violent storms lasting almost every day, except for five days in the year, with rain that breaks for only an hour, acid rain and violent electrical whirlwinds that destroy under armored vehicles, and an ionized atmosphere that made oxygen breathing lifeforms swell in population, but also made repulsive based vehicles nearly impossible to use properly, as well as hampering long range communication and making gunship support impossible. As a result, the Republic had largely abandoned the idea of maintaining the world, instead focusing its efforts on mining the world's rich resources as quickly and efficiently as possible. Once a vast ocean and continental world with beautiful bamboo rainforests and green landscapes, the planet has now started to become abused and in some areas has even turned into a desert. Much to the displeasure of the rapidly growing Jabiim Nationalists movement, who have been displeased with the Republic tampering with their home world.

high_value_targets.name: Alto Stratus
high_value_targets.title: Faction Leader
high_value_targets.intel: Stratus has managed to gain a cult following relatively quickly within the planet's population, much to the discomfort of the Senate. Founder of the Nationalist movement, he is a threat with confirmed ties to the Separatists. This Nationalist movement may become one of the most feverishly loyal to the Separatist cause.

Planet.name: Boz Pity
Planet.description: An uninhabited world of bright green foliage, tiny oceans, rocky fields, grassy fields, and sand filled valleys. Among the valleys and mountains are the death monuments left by the species that went extinct on the planet.

Planet.name: Ruusan
Planet.description: Ruusan is a low plant life planet with bright green waters. Everything on the surface, when the sun is out, is bright lavender and gold. We only know of this planet due to the Jedi knowing of something called “The Valley of the Jedi”. It is almost inaccessible due to the nebula nearby cutting of hyperspace routes.

Planet.name: Bracca
Planet.description: A rocky inhospitable planet that almost never stops raining. Filled mostly with junkyards of massive unusable starships waiting to be deconstructed.

Planet.name: Dotharian
Planet.description: Dotharian is a planet purely of sheer rock cliffs with planets growing unnaturally on the faces of those cliffs. There are a few castles and temples scattered around the planet hanging off of the mountains.

Planet.name: Syvris
Planet.description: The small moon Syvris is a dedicated trade hub for repeat customers with the Hutts. Although pirates are often seen in nearby space the Hutt royals make sure to protect their trade routes. Operations are handled in a large space station within the moon's orbit.

Planet.name: Gamorr
Planet.description: Gamorr is a planet with a range of climates from tundra to jungle. It is the home world of the Gamorrans who are constantly engaged in primitive tribal warfare. They are mercenaries and will fight for goods. The Hutts are hated by them as they regularly enslave the Gamorrans. A CIS taskforce led by the Zygerrian Commander Daynar has established a supply depot on the planet Gamorr. This supply depot is operated by slaves owned by the Zygerrians and other CIS affiliated slave traders. The Hutts previously held a monopoly on slave trading on Gamorr and currently do not appreciate the competition. Additionally the Hutts run a major pod racing event on the world at the ancient ruined Carnuss Gorguul Fortress.

high_value_targets.name: Daynar
high_value_targets.title: CIS Allied Commander
high_value_targets.intel: The Zygerrian undercutting the Hutts in the Gamorran slave trade. He is of immense value to the Hutts and as such if we can capture him we will have a valuable bargaining chip in our dealings with them.

Planet.name: Rothana
Planet.description: This is the planet from where our armies get their vehicles. This is a high priority planet to protect. The planet itself is an arctic tundra. In orbit, the majority of the planet is surrounded by honeycomb ship docks where Kuat Drive Yards work on our future machines.

Planet.name: Fetilia
Planet.description: Fetilia is a planet in the Mid Rim Territories and “The Slice”, Grid Square Q-12, located along the Gamor Run trade route. Fetilia is home to native population of the Fetillians, a species known for having to breathe Tibanna Gas. This would naturally imply that Fetilia does not have a breathable atmosphere. The planet is under Hutt control by the start of the Clone Wars but was not considerably protected given its distance to the inner planets controlled by the Hutt Cartel. The planet itself is quite barren, not able to support oxygen breathing lifeforms. It's just a rocky and desolate planet not too far from being a common asteroid. Its only real strategic value is its high abundance of natural Tibanna Gas which exists as both Liquid and Gas form throughout the planet, while on Fetilia the fuel source is inert due to natural high count of elements that act against the natural combustible nature of Tibana.

Planet.name: Trillia
Planet.description: A large asteroid that is a little too small to be called a planet and is home to the notorious dwarf rathtars. The celestial body is known by smugglers as a dangerous way to gain a fortune. Those who took part in it were looked down upon by fellow smugglers.

Planet.name: Aridus
Planet.description: This planet is largely covered by deserts. Through the deserts were some volcanoes with lava pits. There are some small bodies of water in the form of oases and lakes. Though, there are only a few cities scattered around the planet and they normally are next to a body of water in spire-like tower-cities.

Planet.name: Leritor
Planet.description: The surface of this world is covered mostly by oceans. On the continents, there are very fertile plains due to the never-ending rain storms in the mountains.

Planet.name: Monastery
Planet.description: A rainforest engulfed planet that houses many fierce predators. The topography can be described as bizarre and weird. There is a crystal valley where many jagged crystalline structures jet out of the ground. These structures can burst out of the ground on their own at random times.

Planet.name: Nexus Ortai
Planet.description: Nexus Ortai is classified in both the Mid Rim and “The Slice” regions of the Galaxy, Grid Square Q-14, along two separate trade routes, the Reena Trade Route and the Askar Trace. It is considered a strategic position given its position at the intersection of two hyper lanes. A peaceful planet known for its many trade hubs and a good place to get food, known really for its “Hyper lane Freighter stop” a place one could get a bite to eat, rest and have their ship worked on before moving further. Otherwise the planet is known for its rolling hills and very scenic lakes.

Planet.name: Carlac
Planet.description: Carlac is a snowy planet with mountains and plains. In those plains can be seen trees with bright pink leaves all year ‘round, despite being in the frigid cold. It is also the home of the peaceful Ming Po human clan.

Planet.name: Kholo
Planet.description: A planet of only grassy plains. The planet is separated into two sections: City dwellers and Tribal peoples. Ansion is linchpin planet holding together the GAR from falling apart to the complex interweaving treaties the CIS has made with many other planets.

Planet.name: Glee Anselm
Planet.description: An ocean planet with very little land mass. The sentient species that lives here live deep under the ocean, and due to the darkness of the water night vision is necessary to see anything. The islands that do dot the oceans hold jungles, mountains, and grassy fields.

Planet.name: Numidian Prime
Planet.description: One of the most beautiful jungle planets in the galaxy, Numidian Prime is a prime location for an exotic vacation. It also has many rivers that flow into scattered seas and a few swamps.

Planet.name: Markez
Planet.description: A large moon of an uninhabitable planet. The moon itself is a host for a Rhydonium mine, a highly unstable ship fuel. The mine covers half of the entire moon.

Planet.name: Dorin
Planet.description: A small planet stuck between two black holes. Making the planet mostly devoid of any oxygen. The planet itself was mountainous with large plateaus on those mountains. The weather is also extreme, making it hard to stay outside of shelter when a strom hits.

Planet.name: Rakata Prime
Planet.description: The planet of Rakata Prime, or Lehon to its people, is an ocean world clustered and dotted with numerous islands and archipelagos. It is the only habitable planet within the Lehon system, and was inevitably isolated from the rest of the galaxy due to this. Because of this the Rakatan species would have a silent but rapid rise to power through advanced technology. However, the Rakatans would become a tribalistic people slowly killing themselves in border conflicts and territorial claims. Now the planet is long abandoned and deathly silent. Artifacts, relics, and the remnants of ancient super structures is all that remains.

Planet.name: Lafete
Planet.description: A desert planet used for factories and mega-corporations. The land of Lafete has been drained of all of its fertility and is no longer usable for its agriculture. The barren planet is a popular destination for fugitives and wanderers.

Planet.name: Merokia
Planet.description: An non-descript desert planet near the Unknown Regions with no inhabitants. Although, there are a few areas where destroyed ships can be found.

Planet.name: Zondula
Planet.description: A planet with many rolling mountains that have lush green fields on top of those mountain plateaus. With small oceans of near black water and beaches of sheer cliffs. On this planet there are many temples, which are guarded by jedi.

Planet.name: Gerrigon
Planet.description: A terrestrial astronomical object with an atmosphere. On this object was a once thriving hub for culture and commerce and has since been abandoned. Now the object that was completely filled with a city of white stone and glass is overgrown with nature.

Planet.name: Lutrilla
Planet.description: Lutrillia is an arid and cold planet with only windswept tundras. The world itself is relatively flat with all of its ancient oceans dried up into tiny oases. The local sentient species are a nomad people who live on massive cities on wheels to stay mobile, strip the planet of recourse, and avoid the large predators of the planet who live underground.

Planet.name: Lorta
Planet.description: A planet where all foliage is a shade of bright blue making it look like an ocean planet from space. But there are actually no oceans to be found on this planet, just fields, forests, canyons, and mountains. This planet is home to the violent Lortans who keep threatening the systems nearby. Hopefully they don’t do anything they keep threatening.

Planet.name: Regis Kor
Planet.description: A rocky dwarf planet with a very small atmosphere. There were only 3 inhabited locations on the planet of a primitive sentient species.

Planet.name: Kartoosh
Planet.description: A large object floating in space used by the CIS as a shipyard. A place to build the current Separatist fleet of warships. A discrete complex that allows for swift manufacturing of ships.

Planet.name: Castilion
Planet.description: Castilion is an ocean planet while also having tropical warm weather. There are underwater facilities under the ocean. However, the sea life of Castilion are leviathan in size and highly aggressive.

Planet.name: Blood Gulch
Planet.description: Unknown

Planet.name: Delphania
Planet.description: Dalphania is a colorful planet of red and deep valleys. The fauna is diverse and the native trees can grow to be very large. The lakes are shallow, but there are many of them.

Planet.name: Pam'ba
Planet.description: Pam'ba's climate was diverse due to its carrying terrestrial biomes. Marshlands, rainforests, tall and dry mountains, or deserts that lined the equator.

Planet.name: Codia
Planet.description: A desolate planet with 2 moons. The first is tidally locked to the star, and the second of which is covered in forests and moss.

Planet.name: Xala
Planet.description: Unknown

Planet.name: Batuu
Planet.description: A world of lush forests and mountains, it is a known CIS smuggling hub. It is believed there are hidden CIS factories in the world as well. There is an old abandoned Jedi planet on the world as well. The plantation here comes from all around the galaxy.

Planet.name: Seatos
Planet.description: Unknown

Planet.name: Bakura
Planet.description: This is an agricultural and mining planet with great plains and high mountain ranges. There are only 3 continents with tons of plantations in the west and the mines in the east. Away from the mining there are factories that are integral to the production of repulsorlift coils (giving vehicles the ability to hover). The main city, Salis D'aar, is a massive circular city at the center of the planet.

Planet.name: Dalna
Planet.description: This small planet orbits two suns. Due to the suns, anyone not used to living on this planet will feel sun sickness. Also the weather is very unstable with flooding rains. From orbit the planet is bright blue and white. The planet’s population relies upon agriculture for their economy.

Planet.name: Ponemah
Planet.description: Another sand planet near the likes of Ogem and Jakku. On the southern pole there are constant electromagnetic storms and sandworms.

Planet.name: Cerea
Planet.description: Cerea is relatively underdeveloped technologically speaking. As such the planet is lush farmland, green, and mountains. It is the home world of the Cerean species who are intelligent due to their complex brain formations.

Planet.name: Akiva
Planet.description: A lush jungle planet controlled by the CIS. This planet has multiple large underground droid construction facilities producing B-1 and B-2 Battle Droids, however it is possible a hidden BX Construction Facility is on this planet. Myrra, the Planet’s Capital, was built over a maze of catacombs. Inside of these underground temples is an old Jedi Temple, a Sith Trap, and Hutt Breeding Grounds, not to mention another active Droid Factory.

Planet.name: Rekelos
Planet.description: A large metropolis planet with densely populated cities. Its diverse citizens and communities creates a utopia for outcasts. Bounty hunters are also often found here looking for work wherever possible. A cold planet always shrouded by clouds but always bright because of the neon lights

Planet.name: Genetia
Planet.description: A purple temperate human world. The Genetians are known to be a very peaceful people protesting any military presence on their world.

Planet.name: Ephemera
Planet.description: A spa/resort world that has no solid ground. As such everything is built in the skies and all there is are skies and clouds. The cities are just large resorts where people come to relax and heal due to the gas in the atmosphere that has healing properties.

Planet.name: Polyneus
Planet.description: A backwater and primitive jungle planet with no strategic value. The sentient beings are tribal and live close with nature.

Planet.name: Minfar
Planet.description: Unknown

Planet.name: Patrolia
Planet.description: Patrolia is the aquatic home world of the fishlike Patrolians. As a water world most settlements are under water except for a few floating cities for visitors. The underwater cities do have breathable atmosphere inside many interconnected buildings.

Planet.name: Montross
Planet.description: Located in the mid rim territories. Host to sky cities similar to Bespin. The atmosphere is thin, but still breathable. Often used for military flight academies.

Planet.name: Tirahnn
Planet.description: A warm trade world of forests and mountains, Tirahnn is famous for its grand bazaars. The planet is ruled by the merchant princes and attracts many rich tourists to its markets. As a major trade nexus it is valuable to all the major Galactic Powers.

Planet.name: Uviuy Exen
Planet.description: A moderately populated temperate world it has many ancient ruins from the Alsakan wars. It also hosts some major Republic fortresses acting as a defensive world against any CIS incursion into the core.

Planet.name: Bandomeer
Planet.description: An agricultural and major mining planet, Bandomeer was laden with issues between the miners and the corporations running the mines due to mistreatment. The farming plots here were one of the most major resources of the Republic as this was the primary location for food made for the Grand Army of the Republic and her Clone Troopers. "The planet-wide farms provide a crucial service for the Republic... Without us, clone troopers across the galaxy would starve from lack of rations."

Planet.name: Bonadan
Planet.description: Bonadan was a planet in the Corporate Sector and the primary world in the Bonadan system at the end of the Hydian Way, boasting ten large spaceports. The densely populated planet housed many exotic species from around the galaxy. Bonadanians found off-world were either from wealthy corporate families or those that had escaped the life of corporate servitude.

Planet.name: Corsin
Planet.description: A warm world known for its swoop races, Corsin is a fortress world of the Republic historically used by the Judicial Forces and the Jedi. Now it serves as bulwark against the CIS and a staging ground for Republic assaults. Corsin is also a retreat world with a series of tropical islands that are a gambling hot spot. RSB agents like to use these Casinos for meetings as they are great for privacy while having tight Republic security.

Planet.name: Mikkia
Planet.description: Mikkia has both Icy polar regions and tropical equatorial regions. It is the home world of the Mikkians and a loyal member of the Republic. There are a few cities and some farm land but it is not too heavily populated. The main industry in the world is mining red ore.

Planet.name: Daalang
Planet.description: Large planet shaped asteroids have enough atmosphere to house life. Though the surface is still just space rock with scattered cities.

Planet.name: Daiyu
Planet.description: An urbanized city planet for the lowest and most cut throat criminals. There is a planetwide jammer that does not allow any communication in or out to protect the criminals that live on world. Many fugitives call Daiyu their home.

Planet.name: Antar
Planet.description: Antar is a gas giant with no inhabitants. Antar 4, one of the gas giant’s moons, is home to the Gotal hunters. This moon was a planet on its own. Due to orbiting the gas giant the seasons varied wildly, the magnetism of the planet is extremely strong and can mess with a being's abilities and tech not properly tuned to it. The world moon is water rich with mostly plains.

Planet.name: Exodeen
Planet.description: Exodeen is in the Colonies regions of the Galaxy, Grid Square M-12, along two separate trade routes, Hydian Way and the Nanth’ri Trade Route. Homeworld of the Exodeenians a non-humanoid species that had six arms, six legs and six rows of uneven teeth. The planet has a very dense jungle environment with sparse plains, it features a breathable atmosphere with noticeably high humidity with often long and wet seasons known to the locals as “Daksheshn” which featured heavy rain. The Exodeenians live on the vertical cliff faces commonly found across the planet, adapting the extra limbs for ease of mobility within the environment and extra teeth to crack open the fruit of the Quillvaxia trees.

Planet.name: Chardaan
Planet.description: Chardaan is located in the Inner Rim Territories the Galaxy, Grid Square N-14, it used to be in Grid Square N-13, along two separate trade routes, Shipwrights' Trace and Hydian Way. Chardaan is not actually a planet but an astronomical object, likely a rogue planet, ejected from its home star centuries ago and came to rest in its current position, although study shows it is slowly moving towards the galactic center at a rate of 1 AU per 100 years. Despite not having a home star the planet does house a thriving population. The planet is a swamp jungle environment however it is almost entirely pitch black as having no home star to illuminate its surface the planet's flora and inhabitants have adapted to life without light, either going blind or creating their own light to attract prey. Be wary of large carnivorous plants on its surface. However the planet does feature some form of relief with a breathable atmosphere. Chardaan Shipyards are located here. Chardaan is the headquarters for the Republic 16th Sector Army and the capital of the Pallis Oversector.

Planet.name: Kira
Planet.description: The uninhabitable planet holds no real value for resources. It’s an empty world filled with raw materials, but too hard to extract and refine on the surface.

Planet.name: Pax
Planet.description: Pax is a Gas Giant with many industrial floating Cities and massive space stations going around it. It provides the CIS with much needed Tibbanna Gas serving as a vital refueling station in the region. This makes Pax key to any Naval actions in nearby sectors.

Planet.name: Tibrin
Planet.description: An aquatic planet where the waters are phosphorescent and have skyscraper coral reefs. All cities were either underwater or embedded into the coral reef.

Planet.name: Nevarro
Planet.description: A world of purely black sands and ashen wastelands. Rocky and flat hills that were enveloped in lava lakes and streams. The population lived in the between the lava/ashen fields and the mountains of now dead volcanoes. Their homes are thrown together with white cement in contrast to the blackened ground.

Planet.name: Vondarc
Planet.description: Vondarc is a separatist aligned world and home base of the Malevolence Subjugator-class heavy cruiser. It is a calm temperate world of oceans, and forests with many modern cities.

Planet.name: Steergard
Planet.description: An industrialized astronomical object used for manufacturing naval parts. The air is heavily polluted due to the dense industrial factories spread across the planet. Living conditions are known to be unforgiving, yet the planet’s government does nothing to improve them, as it reaps the wealth generated by manufacturing.

Planet.name: Tiferep
Planet.description: A planet with continental landmasses of grassy plains and thick deserts surrounded by oceans. The inhabitants are space faring but do not live in large cities but in more hut-like villages.

Planet.name: Vandelhelm
Planet.description: A mining planet within the Vandelhelm Cloud. The planet is devoid of much plant life after thousands of years of mining the planet. The sky looks like a never ending rainbow from the space cloud the planet sits in.

Planet.name: Terminus
Planet.description: Terminus is a red desert world full of mesas, yet also has many long canals, and urban centers. A trading hub on the edge of known space, many unfamiliar spaceships are known to frequent Terminus. The architecture in its many urban centers is likewise exotic.

Planet.name: Anoat
Planet.description: Anoat is an ecumenopolis, a city wide planet, the capital of the sector, and the seat of the Nothoiin Noble court. It is a very industrial world with its fair share of slums, and toxic seas. The underworld of toxic sewers is a hub for all kinds of shady activity.

Planet.name: Gerrenthum
Planet.description: Due to the intersection of three major hyperspace lanes, Gerrenthum has become a massive city planet. This is due to the never ending commerce and trade afforded to them from those lanes convergence. As well as a place of respite for individuals partaking in illegal trade.

Planet.name: Geptish
Planet.description: An average floral planet of dense jungle and swamps. There is an old Jedi temple located in one of these jungles which has gone into disrepair from a few hundred years of no use. Though it still houses Jedi secrets that need to be kept from the CIS.

Planet.name: Kriselist
Planet.description: A highly urbanized planet, but not with the sky scrapers of Coruscant. Large cities sprawl the planet with very little vegetation left to be seen.

Planet.name: Kinyen
Planet.description: This planet is an agriworld, or a farming planet. Most of the planet was covered in farms. But in the few places where farms were not present, mountains and forests could be found. Also large dome structures where the majority of the people resided while most of the land was used for farming.

Planet.name: Roona
Planet.description: Home world of the Roonan Species, it holds an important spot among the sector as it holds a strategic importance of the Corellian Trade Spine. Roona is represented by Senator Aang who is of a neutral seat in the Senate, serving on the Military Oversight Committee.

Planet.name: Yag'Dhul
Planet.description: A harsh world where the moons made the tide shift from one side of the planet to the other every few days. Also, due to the erratic movement of the moons, areas of the world will combust into powerful storms, the atmosphere would swirl violently, and lightning crashing onto the scorched surface of the planet. Yag’dul has green vegetation with lush flowing rivers that can suddenly turn into tidal waves washing over the once peaceful plains or even shifting to having no atmosphere in certain areas of the planet freezing everything in place. And where the massive storms are is mostly ash and lava.

Planet.name: Hodi
Planet.description: Situated on the Corellian Run, Hodi was known for its red lakes scattered along the planet. The red was created by the bacteria that infest the water forcing residents to create efficient water filters. Their cities lie on the plains nearby the lakes.

Planet.name: Liwonia
Planet.description: Bestine IV is a planet in the Inner Rim Territories, Grid Square M-14, Trade Route: Corellian Trade Spine. A terrestrial planet with a breathable atmosphere, it features a planetary surface that is almost completely covered in water, with many rugged islands spread across the surface. Among the terrestrial features, it also features plenty of caves, cliffs, island spires, hills and plains. Bestine has a Republic Navy Fleet base. Bsellis City is one of a few major cities on the planet. The large size of its oceans gives it an easy ability to establish large naval repair and construction yards, a fact the Republic took great advantage of.

Planet.name: Nantoon
Planet.description: Nantoon is in the Colonies region of the galaxy, Grid Square M-13, Trade Route: Corellian Trade Spine. This planet is known for being where pirate Queen Maz Kanata hid a portion of her spoils in a buried vault which is protected by an antitamper sub-space alarm. At the time of its notation in Smuggler's Guide by Maz Kanata the alarm had not gone off. The planet does hold some importance to rival gangs and other criminal factions of the region, one such is the Guavian Death Gang, who seeked to launch an attack on the planet to rule over the Galaxy's Underworld. This would imply that the planet is a hub or major locale of criminals. During the time of the Sith Empire Darth Malora besieged the planet, however made a blunder in neglecting to disable the enemies communications. The planet aside from its criminal connections is known for being a dry and arid planet, home to somewhere around 900 million peoples. It features tall mountains and vast deserts.

Planet.name: Allanteen VI
Planet.description: Allanteen VI is a major Republic shipyard. The Allanteen Six shipyards manufactured Venator-class Star Destroyers for the Grand Army of the Republic.

Planet.name: Denon
Planet.description: This ecumenopolis planet is second only to Coruscant in its vastness and coverage. With many straight lines of “roads” emanating from the planet's capital. Glistening towers and endless skylines as far as the eye can see. From the planet’s surface there is little to none natural light anymore.
Planet.conflict_description: Denon is an ecumenopolis world, with city growth covering the entire surface, similar to Coruscant. It is located at the confluence of the Hydian Way and the Corellian Run. The 2nd Sector Army is in charge of defending the vital hyperlane junction at Denon.

Planet.name: Milagro
Planet.description: The planet Milagro lies at the confluence of two important hyperroutes, the Corellian Run and the Harrin Trade Corridor. Milagro is ruled by its own noble houses, descendants of the first settlers of the planet. Milagro is a human dominated world with cities of glass domes and minarets. The planet itself is mostly inhospitable yet its shimmering silicon plains are considered scenic by many. The locals have built up much military infrastructure to defend themselves against pirates. These bases provide an important staging point for whoever controls them for assaults into nearby regions.

Planet.name: New Cov
Planet.description: New Cov is located in the Churba sector of the Mid Rim, at the junction of the Corellian Run and the Duros Space Run. A jungle planet where the conditions are so harsh the locals have built dome cities to shelter from the lethal flora. The diverse flora is incredibly vibrant. That even subtly glows in the night. However, there are many deadly and docile wildlife throughout the planet.

Planet.name: Falleen
Planet.description: Falleen is the ancient home world of the notorious species of the same name. Removed from the criminal underworld of the Black Sun, it is a monarchical society run by the Falleen King. Its jungles, vast plains, and icy mountains are both respected and well used by its people for ancestral and defensive measures. After the Battle of Naboo, the planet saw a rise in corporate interest in its landscapes, and soon, some of the most prominent manufacturers in the galaxy would begin to build operations upon its surface. Seeing an opportunity to take advantage of the trade routes and the less remote nature of the planet. This same boom in the economy would further strengthen the King, allowing them to build vast citadels and fortresses upon the planet's surface.

high_value_targets.name: King of Falleen
high_value_targets.title: King
high_value_targets.intel: The King of Falleen is the linchpin when it comes to the loyalty of the Falleen people. While the planet's independence is respected by the Republic, if he were to ever change his loyalties, the Republic must prepare to respond in kind.

Planet.name: Ando
Planet.description: Ando the homeworld of the Aqualish is a world of large oceans with only a few swampy islands on the surface, yet they are host to ancient overgrown Sith temples and some dense ancient cities. It is in an ongoing civil war over remaining with the separatists. The faction led by Vagger wants to join the republic but is opposed by Nudo who leads separatists on the world. The Hyper-Communications Cartel, the CIS propaganda and signals division also operate around the world with their headquarters having lots of valuable intel on CIS subversive activities.

high_value_targets.name: Senator Po Nudo
high_value_targets.title: Corrupt Senator
high_value_targets.intel: He is the Aqualish separatist Senator of Ando. He is also head of the Hyper-Communications Cartel, the CIS propaganda and signals division.

high_value_targets.name: Mekedrix
high_value_targets.title: Traitor
high_value_targets.intel: He is the insane human traitor to the republic and leader of the rogue Death Wind squad. These former Republic militia members are to be executed for treason.

Planet.name: Druckenwell
Planet.description: Druckenwell is an industrial world in the Lambda sector, on the Corellian Run. A Trade Federation world, it is loyal to the Confederacy of Independent Systems. It is best known for a BlasTech weapons manufacturing complex that is located there.

high_value_targets.name: Arelius L’att
high_value_targets.title: CEO
high_value_targets.intel: Arelius I’att is the human CEO of I'att Armament whoever controls him controls the arms factories of the world. He is protected by his own private security including the latest model of assassin droid.

Planet.name: Mon Gazza
Planet.description: The planet of Mon Gazza was once home to a spice mining colony, second only to Kessel in spice mining production. A violent, poverty-stricken world, it was controlled by the Galactic Spice Mining Guild.

high_value_targets.name: Jinn Reeso
high_value_targets.title: Guild Commander
high_value_targets.intel: Newly appointed quarren governor replaced the former neutral one. Given the fact that his species are deeply affiliated with the Trading Federation, there are speculations that he plans to support the Confederacy.

Planet.name: Hypori
Planet.description: After the Invasion of Naboo in 32 BBY, Hypori was transformed into a droid factory world by the Techno Union and Trade Federation.

Planet.name: Arctic Prime
Planet.description: Hynestia Prime was a cold tundra planet in the Colonies. Due to its frigid climate, only the area around the equator was habitable to its human population. Underground, the planet had extensive systems of caves and hot springs.

Planet.name: Yavin IV
Planet.description: Yavin IV is considered to be a relatively unimportant planet to the majority of the galaxy at large. However, its landscapes hide deeply rooted secrets long forgotten through thousands of years of abandonment. Yavin IV had once been the temple world of Exar Kun’s Sith Empire. The massive rainforests, jungles, swamps, and mountains covering its surface made it the perfect world to hide the Sith Lords' artifacts and secrets. Yet the true purpose of these temples and the moon itself would have been long lost to time, with only the Jedi Order having records of its ancient structures. Interestingly, these same records show an underground infrastructure and city that was built into the planet sometime after Exar Kun’s removal from the world by the Jedi during the Old Republic. Records on its purpose seem to have been expunged, but the Republic has started sending archeologists to investigate.

Planet.name: Rishi Moon
Planet.description: A desolate moon. It has holes scattered around the surface which stretch deep into the moon as well as many interconnecting cave systems. The moon is used as a listening post by the Republic.

Planet.name: Milvayne
Planet.description: Milvayne is controlled internally by the Milvayne Authority, a harsh, justice-oriented law enforcement agency. Appearing green from above, most of Milvayne was covered in the expansive and crowded Milvayne City. Similar to Coruscant, the city had both upper and lower portions, and most were controlled extremely well by mass propaganda, that is until you get to the underworld. All citizens of Milvayne were tried for crimes at a ledge, if found guilty you were thrust off the ledge and into the underworld. Here, it was a lawless place filled with homeless in disarray, cannibals, or low tier bounty hunters and criminals.

Planet.name: Pijal
Planet.description: Pijal was a planet in the Inner Rim territories, controlled largely by the Czerka Corporation. A planet of large islands of green and gold with massive cliffs on the beaches. Inland there were mountains and thick forests They are only situated around the equator, whereas the rest of the planet is ocean.

Planet.name: Bilbringi
Planet.description: A nondescript planet with shipyards specifically designed for dismantling starships.

Planet.name: Roost
Planet.description: Devshi is an ocean moon in the Inner Rim, but its seas are relatively shallow compared to most ocean worlds. This makes it an ideal location for a Republic prison facility built on the seafloor, where dangerous criminals can be securely contained far from the rest of the galaxy.

Planet.name: Couronne
Planet.description: Couronne is a cold desert world and is the homeworld of the Imzig. The population does not engage in farming, getting all their food from the outside world and they all live in urban centers. It is ruled by the High King Valois from his palatial skyscraper. There is much civil unrest amongst the High Court and the King only maintains order through the High King’s Guard, an elite force. Being a neutral in the war he plays both the Republic and the CIS against each other doing nothing to prevent raids on each other's embassies, even encouraging it. This is because he has two rivals Duke Juori who is supported by the Republic and Duke Lesanne who is supported by the CIS.

high_value_targets.name: High King Valois
high_value_targets.title: King
high_value_targets.intel: He is the Imzig High King of Couronne. His capture will give us the leverage needed to have him abdicate in favour of the Republic Loyalist Duke Juori.

high_value_targets.name: Duke Juori
high_value_targets.title: Duke
high_value_targets.intel: The Imzig Duke Juori of Couronne is under constant threat of assaination from both the neutral High King and the rival Duke Lesanne who is for his support of the Republic.

high_value_targets.name: Duke Lesanne
high_value_targets.title: Duke
high_value_targets.intel: The Imzig Duke Lesanne of Couronne is the local CIS puppet. The only thing worse than Couronne remaining neutral, is it joining the CIS. Eliminate him to stop all CIS influence on the world.

Planet.name: Madrigal
Planet.description: Rima Torrik is a temperate planet located in the Colonies region.

Planet.name: Zardossa Stix
Planet.description: Zardossa Stix was a desert moon located in the Zardossa Stix system of the galaxy's Colonies region. It was the site of an ancient temple built in honor of Malmourral, the Bardottan demon of war.

Planet.name: Caraad
Planet.description: A cold and mountainous world, Caraad was located in the Colonies. It was connected to Palanhi by the Shwuy Exchange hyperspace route. Caraad included cities built amongst the planet's snowy peaks, the city had speeder traffic, residential housing, with vendors selling food, flowers, and more. In addition to the cold, the planet was also windy.

Planet.name: Vakkar
Planet.description: Vakkar was a planet located within the Fakir Sector of the Colonies. It is a minor planet with a breathable atmosphere. Though it's not an inhabited planet, the world is home to a diverse range of fauna. The wildlife is also very docile with a rich amount of raw materials beneath the surface. Massive mountain ranges stretch across the planet that form impassable barriers that separate entire continents from one another.

Planet.name: Palanhi
Planet.description: Palanhi is a crossworlds planet in the Colonies region. A small planet with a singular continent. On that continent are regular forests and plains. The planet is housing a major bank that holds a large portion of the GAR’s treasury.

Planet.name: Bestoon
Planet.description: Bestoon is a planet in the Colonies and “The Interior” regions of the Galaxy, Grid Square J-9. Bestoon is an arid and inhospital wasteland of a planet, with hardly any atmosphere, aside from concentration around the poles of the planet, it features no bodies of water on the planet, it does have a native species the Bestoonians a tan humanoid species with taut skin, adapted to the low water environment of Bestoon. Bestoon itself is known for not much as not many people willingly spend their time on the surface as once noted “Not much is worth being on that planet for”. Although, the people who decide to call Bestoon their home are always a criminal.

Planet.name: Ghorman
Planet.description: Ghorman was a Colonies planet located in the Sern sector’s Ghorman system along the Rimma Trade Route. The planet was known for its streamlined high-quality silk and twill industy, and it was considered a rite of passage for new fashion designers to visit the planet. Much of the population worked in the silk and twill industry, and the planet's people, the Ghor, took pride in their language and their culture.

Planet.name: Abednedo
Planet.description: Abednedo was a planet located on the Corellian Run and in the Abednedo system of the galaxy's Colonies region. It was the home world of the sentient Abednedo species. The Abednedo people created cities of vibrant color and chaotic artistry. They have cave systems that stretch very far as that is their original civilization before living on the surface. The rest of the planet was desert and rocky.

Planet.name: Bardotta
Planet.description: Bardotta is a remote planet located in the Colonies region. Renowned for the art and music produced by the simple locals, the planet is ruled by a monarch who is guided by the Dagoyan Order, a group reputed for their mysticism and attention to spiritual matters.

Planet.name: Fondor
Planet.description: Fondor could be considered a miniature Coruscant in many ways. The planet showed signs of having once been a forested coastal world; however, after the Techno Union began operations on the planet, as well as expanding its infrastructure, they would quickly convert its surface into factories, cooling towers, mines, cities, workers’ barracks, and office complexes. The Guild of Shipwrights would begin to form out of the Techno Unions' ambition to create a planetary shipyard to rival Kuat. However, those ambitions would never truly be met, despite the planet's state of the art droid brains that covered major districts of work and labor within the different mining and fabrication sectors across the planet. Despite the planet's alignment with the Techno Union and their droid overseers, the people of Fondor are less than loyal to the Separatist cause.

Planet.name: Sandstorm
Planet.description: The boneyard.

Planet.name: Dowut
Planet.description: A frigid windswept planet of bland grey landscapes where no plants can grow. The planet has 3 stars in the sky making it so there is almost no nighttime. The cold tundra did not prevent wildlife from sprouting. The Dowutin people are generally isolated and although a part of the Republic they avoided politics.

Planet.name: Angcord
Planet.description: Angcord was a planet in the galaxy mostly covered in water, with numerous rocky islands blanketed with green trees.

Planet.name: N'Zoth
Planet.description: N'Zoth is a desert planet in the Core Worlds. The brutal, xenophobic Yevetha were the planet's only sentient species. However, there are other brutal species on N'zoth. Known to be a solitary planet and aggressive against outsiders. The people's xenophobia has driven a rift against them and the Republic.

Planet.name: Altis
Planet.description: Cal-Seti was a planet located in the Core Worlds and was several sectors from N'zoth. It was at the intersection of the Agricultural Circuit and the Metellos Trade Route. It is an industrial planet used for processing goods.

Planet.name: Abregado
Planet.description: A major manufacturing and trade-oriented planet, sitting at the beginning of the Rimma Trade Route. Unlike most Core Worlds, Abregado-rae was fairly backward, to the point of being compared with worlds in the Outer Rim Territories. The planet's spaceports seemed safe, at least to the untrained eye, but in fact it was a known smuggler's paradise.

Planet.name: Neimoidia
Planet.description: Neimodia is a warm world with large open orange fungal farms maintained by massive harvester beetles contained by long stretches of laser fences. The Nemoians here live in large palatial estates or condensed brutal cities. Neimoida is the world where most Nemiodians are born as it is host to the most grub hatcheries. It is also a farming world for the Nemoidians as it is host to their fungal farms. Neimoida is also home to the Trade Monarch, the nominal leader of all Nemodians.

high_value_targets.name: Trade Monarch
high_value_targets.title: Leader of all Nemodians
high_value_targets.intel: His capture is crucial in bringing the Trade Federation to heel and perhaps bring an end to this war.

Planet.name: Zonama Sekot
Planet.description: A most unusual planet. The planet itself is a living being. As such, the planet is nomadic in nature. This allows it to move to wherever they want to. The planet surface has only one continent spanning the entire planet with a few lakes and seas. It is mostly made of tropical jungles and a northern pole was pure white with snow.

Planet.name: Mygeeto
Planet.description: Banking Clan crystal vaults we held here in the icy planet. The vault waws well hidden in the jagged crystalline landscape. However, it is highly secured by the wealthy banking clan.

Planet.name: Dromund Kaas
Planet.description: Once the ancient capital of the Sith Empire, Dromund Kaas is now a shadow of its former glory. Ancient cults and Sith fanatics now roam its hallowed grounds. Legends and rumors are all that circulate about the existence of Dormund Kaas in the modern Republic, as communications and travel to the planet have been prohibited, or even deleted from civilian star charts. However, what is known about the planet, based upon its previous records, is that it is a deeply forested environment and highly dangerous to adventure into. Beasts and experiments of the Ancient Sith species stalk the eternal nights of the planet, waiting for the perfect opportunity to strike the ill-prepared. Ancient structures of old Imperial armories, fortresses, cities, Sith academies, and tombs cover its surface. Both it and Moraband have been long forgotten, and for most, it is preferred that it stays that way. Some things are meant to be left alone, never to be returned to or to be reawakened.

Planet.name: Saleucami
Planet.description: Saleucami, in its native tongue, means “oasis,” and this is truly apt as the planet is one of the only habitable planets in its system. Saleucami is a forested mountain world covered in thick trees and massive rocky formations. The planet itself has no sentient life to speak of; however, it has been considered a paradise worth settling by different species within the galaxy. Its temperate weather is perfect for sustaining life. Interestingly, despite the world's relative peace, it is consistently at threat from meteor strikes, an issue that the planetary government of Salecami is well aware of and seeking to rectify. Currently under direct control of the Techno Union, it is considered a luxury world for the upper class living within its cities, outside of the farming population in its forests.

Planet.name: Korriban
Planet.description: This desolate planet is relatively empty other than the fierce animals and fauna. Everything on the planet from the caves to the mountains are red and oppressive. It has many Sith tombs and temples scattered all over the planet. The ancient architecture holds secrets known to only few and some will never be discovered.

Planet.name: Ilum
Planet.description: Illum is a cold world with ice cliffs and snowy forests. It is also a hidden world where the Jedi take younglings to get their kyber crystals for light sabers. With this many inexperienced Jedi on the world and with the Jedi spread thin they will need protection.

Planet.name: Polis Massa
Planet.description: Polis Massa was a planetoid in a dense asteroid field located in the Subterrel sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, far from any major hyperspace lanes. At some point, Polis Massa was a planet located within the system of the same name. The planet was home to a subterranean people called the Eellayin until it was destroyed. But the rocky fragments of the planet still held relics of the Eelayin, which were collected and studied by Kallidahin archaeologists. This planetoid and its surrounding belt are home to several excavation sites and research facilities that are trying to uncover what happened to the planet and her people.

Planet.name: Kalee
Planet.description: Home world to the Kaleesh people. They are a spiritual species and their architecture reflects that with grandiose temples. The world consists of green plains mixed with rocky cliffs and large oceans.

Planet.name: Muunilinst
Planet.description: Muunilinst is the Banking Clan Headquarters. It consists of large cities, open plains, and massive reed forests. Places of note are the Banking Clan Headquarters, and the massive ground based orbital defenses. The Banking Clans influential grasp upon the galaxy officiated Muunilinst’s wealth within the galaxy. An urban complex for rich elites.

Planet.name: Belsavis
Planet.description: The planet’s surface is covered in ice except for small areas that are geothermically heated by active micro-volcanoes. The patches of oasis uncover valuable resources heavily desired for naval warships. However, with the limited amount that is accessible the CIS took over the planet to exploit its mining reserves.

Planet.name: Ziost
Planet.description: Once considered the gateway to the Empire, the planet of Ziost connected multiple Sith worlds via hyperspace lanes. At one point in time, the planet was even the capital of the Ancient Sith Empires before the Galactic Cold War. That, however, was hundreds, if not thousands, of years before its ultimate fate. No matter what the world had once been, landscape or relevance, it does not matter in the modern age of the Republic. The planet would end up being the genocidal birthplace of the original Sith Emperor of the modern Sith Empires. Tenebrae, the Lord of all Sith, went by many names. His creation would be the death of an entire world and all of its essence, all of the Force itself, being consumed by him. In an ancient ritual where he brought about the downfall of his people, consuming all who had participated, using their strength to further finish his consumption of the planet. The once proud capital was reduced to ash and silenced in but moments. The Force itself is void and absent. Monstrous creatures devoid of all life roam the planet, seeking to consume the very life from victims that stumble upon the dead world.

Planet.name: Jedha
Planet.description: A planet with vast deserts and sheer cliff mountain range as well as colorful mesas. The planet also hosts diverse wildlife that have adapted to the harsh climate. Jedha has a large amount of Kyber crystal deposits along with multiple sandstone temples over the top of those deposits.

Planet.name: Zygerria
Planet.description: Zygerria is the homeworld of the Slaver Zygerrians who build their cities on lush mesas surrounded by an arid savanna. Zygerrian cities are known for their large slave markets, and massive places. Their slave fighting arenas host a variety of dangerous and exotic animals.

Planet.name: Malachor V
Planet.description: Malachor, or Malachor V, is a haunted planet. Deeply entrenched in one of the darkest days of the Old Republic, the planet is a tomb. All that makes up its surface is rock, ash, and mountains of long-abandoned and barren landscapes. To venture to Malachor is to seek out the ghosts of long-forgotten mistakes. And yet many adventurers and fortune seekers still brave the surface of the planet covered in eternal storm, hoping to find long relics and artifacts from the age of the Ancient Jedi and Sith.

Planet.name: Ossus
Planet.description: A planet affiliated with the Jedi order, the place of the first Jedi Temple. After an intense battle during the old Republic era the planet was decimated, few jedi survived becoming tribal Ysanna. The planet was known to have grassy plains and a connection to force sensitive people.

Planet.name: Zeltros
Planet.description: Zeltros is the home of the Zeltron species, a race of near-human aliens that have a specialized connection to emotions and a pheromone that allows them to comfort and calm almost any individual. Due to this, the Zeltron people have marketed their world to whoever has been the ruler of the galaxy at large. They offer services for either pleasure or party to the highest bidder. Currently, Zeltros finds itself as the premier pleasure world of the Republic, hosting Governors, Politicians, Senators, Generals, Admirals, and even Chancellors if they fancy. It is a world to escape the woes of the galaxy at large, and yet it is also often used as a hidden punishment for failure. Removing problematic individuals within the Republic to keep them satiated and quiet. The planet itself is a temperate coastal world, with beaches and palm trees covering its surface.

Planet.name: Takodana
Planet.description: A world of short tree forests and a ton of tiny lakes scattered across the surface. There are random temples dotted around the world that have been converted into resorts and castles for rich aristocrats. As well as a smuggler's haven.

Planet.name: Kiffu
Planet.description: Kiffu is home to the near human Kiffar. It is also an arid world, with many deserts, and mountains. The CIS have invaded and are brutally suppressing the locals. This is an occupation which many locals fight against yet each time they try they are suppressed.

Planet.name: Bothawui
Planet.description: Bothawui is the homeworld of the Bothans. It is a temperate world of forests, mountains, and cities in the pains between. With many cities and academies including Republic Naval academies being a center of learning in the sector making it of the utmost importance to the Republic Navy. The world is also a center of commerce and space traffic being host to some major spaceports. It also hosts an extensive asteroid field around a nearby Gas Giant that is the predicted host spot for all spacebattles in the region.

Planet.name: Tython
Planet.description: Tyton is a world of forests, snow capped mountains, and grassy plains. Tython is a very important world to the Jedi as it is considered the origin point of the Jedi order in some legends. There are many Jedi ruins throughout the world that the Order does not want desecrated; all trespassers are to be executed.

Planet.name: Serenno
Planet.description: Serenno is a planet of mountains, blue tree forests, and savannas with the occasional city. Of particular importance is Dooku's palace and Great Assembly House which are important locations for the CIS holding valuable intel. Additionally the Spike is an important CIS prison holding many important members of the Republic including Jedi.

high_value_targets.name: Count Dooku
high_value_targets.title: Leader of the CIS
high_value_targets.intel: The former Jedi and now Sith Confederate Head of State.

high_value_targets.name: Moralo Eval
high_value_targets.title: Bounty Hunter
high_value_targets.intel: He is a Phindian criminal mastermind and serial killer. He is responsible for a plot to assassinate the Chancellor.

high_value_targets.name: Separatist Intelligence Informant
high_value_targets.title: Republic Spy
high_value_targets.intel: A republic spy in the heart of the Separatist intelligence agency he needs extraction before his cover is blown as he has intel vital to the republic.

Planet.name: Ord Trasi
