Planet.description: As a major ship building planet, it is encircled by a massive shipyard ring. On the surface there are thousands of mines churning out the rare materials and metals that help with the shipyard.

Planet.name: Ord Mantell
Planet.description: A military supply world Ord Mantel is heavily controlled by the Black Sun syndicate from behind the scenes. Ord Mantel is a mountainous, arid world, with large seas.

Planet.name: Ringo Vinda
Planet.description: A civilian graving dock surrounded Ringo Vinda in space. It was used for ship maintenance, repair, and construction. It is filled with long corridors and choke points. Many civilians can be found here while they are traveling or selling, it is a hub for the economy.

Planet.name: Dxun
Planet.description: Dxun, otherwise known as the “Demon Moon”, is an ancient and culturally important moon to the True Mandalorians. The moon is covered in thick, overgrown forests, swamps, and mountains. It was once considered the stronghold world of Mandalore the Ultimate, and as such, it is covered in ancient Mandalorian architecture and defensive positions. The Mandalorian Wars scars can be seen within a majority of the moon's surface as ancient starships, the skeletons of warriors long forgotten, and burial sites left behind in its bombardment by the Old Republic. The moon’s fauna and wildlife are some of the deadliest and most hostile in the galaxy, having once slaughtered Mandandalore the Indomitable. Due to this and its unimportance to the galaxy at large, the moon has been mostly abandoned and left to the annals of time.

Planet.name: Wayland
Planet.description: A lush semi-tropical planet with many forests and mountains. Here, a core Separatist R&D base exists and is led by genetic Terrorist Zeta Magnus. Further knowledge of this planet is scarce due to an admin filing error removing all records of the planet out of the astrogation charts and planetary logs.

Planet.name: Lah'mu
Planet.description: The remote farming world Lah'mu held many minor farms which sustained its small economy. It is a planet of large dirt plains and scattered mounds of grass. The soil was fertile and at times difficult to traverse.

Planet.name: Onderon
Planet.description: Onderon is a warm human world of blue jungles, red messas, lakes, and old ruins. Every city is walled due to the dangerous wildlife that makes life outside of them difficult. The CIS are trying to overthrow the current King Ramsis Dendup with the usurper Sanjay Rash.

high_value_targets.name: Sanjay Rash
high_value_targets.title: CIS Royal Usurper
high_value_targets.intel: Help the Onderonian loyalists bring him to justice.

high_value_targets.name: General Kalani
high_value_targets.title: CIS Command
high_value_targets.intel: Commands CIS forces on the ground and the next generation of T-Series.

high_value_targets.title: King Ramsis Dendup
high_value_targets.intel: Being held prisoner in his own Palace in the Capital in Iziz.

Planet.name: Teth
Planet.description: This planet is a rocky jungle scaped planet. The jungle is made up of trees that twist with each other as they grow. The planet is scattered with many temples from the species that originally lived on the planet but have since gone extinct. These temples are positioned on top of the rock structures that jut far above the jungle. The Hutts now inhabit those temples and have converted them into strongholds. The world is in a state of hazy purple due to the atmosphere and thick fog.

Planet.name: Raxus
Planet.description: A frozen Ice world Raxus contains the ancient ruin of Xim's empire with their ancient battle droids possibly frozen within. The CIS use the world as a hidden fortified base near their capital Raxus Secundus.

Planet.name: Raxus Secundus
Planet.description: A temperate world of wide plains, tall mountains, oceans, and orange forests Raxus Secundus is the Capital of the CIS. As such it is host to the Separatist Senate, the most important location in the Confederacy. Many secretive diplomatic talks have been held there by the peace faction of the Republic in an attempt to end the war.

high_value_targets.name: Mina Bonteri
high_value_targets.title: Senator
high_value_targets.intel: She is a human Separatist senator who is interested in negotiating an end to the war. Dooku and his lackeys wish to prevent this at all costs; she will be difficult to get to.

Planet.name: Gridlock
Planet.description: akku is a planet in the Inner Rim and Western Reaches regions of the galaxy, Grid Square I-13 along the Burke Trailing hyperspace lane. Jakku is a desert planet with a breathable atmosphere and it is the home world of the Teedo and Uthuthma species. Jakku is considered by many to be worthless, distant and unimportant. Jakku once had forests and water, and some rare remnants near the poles still show life, although ancient evidence of this once prosperous time. Jakku has some importance for the occasional mining operation that will go belly up eventually. It also has some Buttes located on the south of the planet which lichen can be harvested from to be turned into the alcohol “Knockback Nectar”.

Planet.name: Myrkr
Planet.description: Unusually, this planet has a strange tree that has an extremely high metal content. These trees mess with most sensors. Otherwise there are a few plains, some low mountains, and a few port cities.

Planet.name: Shili
Planet.description: Home to the sentient tortuga species, colorful grasslands, expansive pine tree forests and rolling hills, and famous for melodramatic holovids. Shili is a longtime member of the Galactic Republic and the original home of several notable Jedi. Many beasts also call this planet home such as the Akul, a formidable beast requiring multiple tribes of Togruta to work together to defeat it.

Planet.name: Umbara
Planet.description: Umbara, otherwise known as the “Shadow World,” is a planet that's covered in eternal darkness. Not receiving the majority of sunlight from its star, its people have never seen the light of day. Umbara itself is a deeply forested overgrowth world, and while it is not fully sentient, unlike Kashyyyk and Felucia, it is ripe with living fauna that seek to kill and consume those that get near them. Umbara is also a natural world that harbors Doonium, making it the perfect world to mine the valuable resource for ship production. Interestingly, the planet had once been the homeworld of the New Sith Empire under the Brotherhood of Darkness. Rumor says that the Sith academies that once hid within its mountains may yet still exist.

Planet.name: Malastare
Planet.description: The dry purple desert planet of Malastare was home to the Dugg species. The fauna was generally barren due to an important toxic fuel that resided under the planet’s surface. The fuel was valuable as it was necessary for military and commercial products. However, the extraction of the fuel is dangerous because of predators who have evolved into large beasts, almost impossible to neutralize. Nonetheless, the Dugg people have created refineries to fuel their economy as well as their podracers.

Planet.name: Dantooine
Planet.description: Dantooine is a farming planet with very mild weather. Most of the surface consists of grassy plains and rolling hills. Some of these hills are dotted with Balba trees. There are some forested hills containing creeks, rivers, and lakes.

Planet.name: Devaron
Planet.description: The jungle planet Devaron is the home world of the Devaronian species. The natural beauty of the planet was deliberately maintained by the natives, making sure of the ecosystem's health. The Devaronian's shared desire to keep the planet unsullied by over industrialization is a phenomenon compared to the rest of the galaxy. The natives provided a place for the wild life to thrive and become connected deeply to the Force.

Planet.name: Raxus Prime
Planet.description: Raxus Prime is a junk world underbelly of the CIS. What regions aren’t covered in garbage are either toxic seas or smog producing factories. The piles of trash bury the ruins of the Tion Civilization. It also hosts a secret fortress of Count Dooku somewhere in the world.

Planet.name: Florrum
Planet.description: A desert world hideout for Pirates the only source of water is through the occasional geyser. The Hondo Ohnaka Gang is the main Pirate gang operating out of a series of massive fortified complexes. They have very impressive holding cells for prisoners considering they are a Pirate gang even capable of holding Jedi, and their complexes are more like fortresses capable of resisting a full on assault. These pirates are not to be underestimated as they have weaponry to match any of the major powers.

high_value_targets.name: Hondo Ohnaka
high_value_targets.title: Pirate Leader
high_value_targets.intel: Hondo Ohnaka is the elusive leader of the largest Pirate Gang commanding them from his fortified complex. He is wanted by both the Republic and CIS

Planet.name: Anaxes
Planet.description: Discovered first by one of the original ancient human civilizations before the age of the Republic, the Azure Imperium, Anaxes is an ancient fortress world and a bastion of strength within the Republic. Anaxes is a deeply forested, swampy, and mountainous world with cities and Republic bases scattered all across its surface. Deeply cultural to the Republic Navy, it is also a major staging ground for the First Army of the Republic and the training ground for Republic naval cadets. Academies and schools make up just as much of its infrastructure as its production lines and army barracks. Above the planet's surface, it holds one of the largest and most well-armed shipyards in the Republic fleet. Containing the ships and defensive fleet of not only the planet itself but the First Army. Vitally important to the Republic's war effort and recruitment, the planet is one of, if not the most important, military planets in the Republic's arsenal.

Planet.name: Brentaal
Planet.description: Brentaal is a warm world of large swaths of farm land, winding rivers, jungles, and massive walled cities mostly compiled of warehouses. These warehouses were important due to the trade importance of Brentaal as it lied in the middle of important trade routes. The locals are heavily pro-separatist having assisted Shogar Tok a local warlord based out of a former prison turned fortress in conquering the planet as soon as the Clone War started.

high_value_targets.name: Shogar Tok
high_value_targets.title: Human Separatist Leader
high_value_targets.intel: Droid commander on a world based out of a former prison turned fortress. The locals adore him and have also taken up arms to assist him.

high_value_targets.name: Zolghast
high_value_targets.title: Zygerrian CIS Commander
high_value_targets.intel: He keeps a body guard of Geonosians and is extremely paranoid of getting captured; willing to have his own troops obliterate his position to prevent it.

Planet.name: Ord Cestus
Planet.description: Ord Cestus a red desert planet with the occasional volcano is the homeworld of the X'Ting although the human dominated Cestus Cybernetics, a subset of the Techno Union now rule the world. The world mainly produces fungi from fungal farms and droids for the CIS from factories owned by Cestus Cybernetics. The working conditions on the world are horrific and Cestus Cybernetics is only able to maintain their control of the world through their droid army.

Planet.name: Carida
Planet.description: A mostly barren planet with many high mountains. It also features frozen ice fields and rain forests. But the gravity on this planet is much higher than the average habitable planet.

Planet.name: Iridonia
Planet.description: Home to the Zabraks, this planet is generally arid and rough to live in. Sporting harsh red plains with carnivorous beasts around every corner. However, The harsh living has created a reliance upon cityscapes by the locals.

Planet.name: Byss
Planet.description: An isolated planet that was lush with bright green plants and fields. The waters are brighter blue than most other Naboo-like planets with lakes and rivers in long chains through grand plateaus and canyons. Byss had no forests, only ferns and lichens.

Planet.name: Cato Neimoidia
Planet.description: A perpetually foggy planet, shrouded by geysers that spewed water from its acidic, planet-wide oceans. Tower-like rock formations and massive natural arches rose from these seas, and upon them lay the plains and forests. The Neimoidians lived in dense cities of metal-vined bridges that spanned between the towering rock structures.

high_value_targets.name: Trade Federation Middle Management Employee
high_value_targets.intel: Holds a high enough position to gain intel from with not enough power within the Trade Federation to be noticed if he would go missing.

Planet.name: Rhen Var
Planet.description: Rhen Var was once a fertile paradise filled with vegetation and wildlife. However, sometime thousands of years before the modern era, the planet was hit with a devastating cataclysm. Now it is an icy and glacial planet covered in frost and snow-covered mountains and tundra. Once a citadel world for the Rakatan Empire, the planet is now a tomb world for the ancient Jedi, long after the Rakatan's defeat at their hands. Castles, fortresses, and catacombs of ancient empires and civilizations cover its surface. Currently, the planet finds itself as a listening post for the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Planet.name: Mimban
Planet.description: A perpetually overcast world due to the extremely ionized atmosphere. And in the marshes of the planet it is in constant fog and mist. Other than the marshes Mimban is populated with rainforests and swamps. Due to the highly sought after hyperbaride the CIS have many mining rigs on the surface.

Planet.name: Manaan
Planet.description: An ocean world, it is the home world of the Selkath. The only surface city is the massive floating city of Ahto which was built to accommodate non aquatic species. Their main product is Kolto which is a cheaper substitute to bacta.

Planet.name: Telos IV
Planet.description: Uniquely, a quarter of this planet’s sky was covered by Citadel Station, a massive space station constructed by the High Republic. This planet is also home to a Jedi Temple and old Jedi Academy located on its northern pole, but both have remained hidden for several eras. More importantly, this planet sits at the edge of Galactic Republic controlled space on the strategic Hydian Way Hyper lane.

Planet.name: Ithor
Planet.description: Ithor is a forest planet home to the Ithorians who believed their lush jungles were sacred. Hunting is strictly prohibited on this planet as the wildlife is respected by the world’s people. The forests were filled with dense trees and carnivorous fauna. Ithorians often built their cities away from their forests, in barren lands, in order to keep the land pure.

Planet.name: Taris
Planet.description: Taris was once the jewel of the Republic, a city of splendor, pleasure, and hidden arenas of violence that even managed to outshine Coruscant in its brightest days. Yet fate would betray the once proud planet. In the age of Darth Malek, the planet, at first, would see a new boom of entertainment and prosperity under Sith occupation. Yes, the Rakgul threat in the under-city was ignored by the occupiers; however, the upper levels saw an unprecedented level of credits flowing from the now-evident black markets and fighting pits forming in the Republicless world. This small age of wealth would come to an abrupt and ruthless end as Darth Malek, in an attempt to stop Revan and Bastilla Shan from leaving the planet, would orbitally bombard every inch of its surface. For thousands of years, the Rakguls would control the world, and its people would struggle to survive within the regrowth of ancient forests. With the uniting of the Galaxy under the Galactic Republic, the planet has finally received the aid it had needed for millennia. Finally stepping back on its feet, though still facing underlying Rakgul invasions from the under-city, Taris has begun to rebuild.

high_value_targets.name: Kim Robb
high_value_targets.title: Senator
high_value_targets.intel: Senator Robb is a major reason for Taris’s return as an ecumenopolis. Her capability to work with other Senators on public policies and humanitarian issues have allowed her the opportunity to fix her world. Yet many within the Republic see the regrowth of Taris on the galactic stage as a threat to their power base. Thus, the Senator's life is paramount.

Planet.name: Hapes
Planet.description: The Hapes Consortium is a feverishly independent government that lives within the Hapes system. After the women of the planet had been enslaved by the Lorell Raiders of the Old Republic, and subsequently the Raiders were killed by the Jedi Order, the surviving mothers of the children of the Raiders vowed never again to let a man rule their society. For 3000 years, they have used the deadly Transitory Mists nebulae to conceal their worlds and keep outside vessels from entering their sector. Progressing aggressively and hoarding their technologies against an ever-growing and yet self-destructive galaxy, the Hapes seek to solidify utter dominance over ship-based combat and shielding technologies. Hoping that such advancements would protect them if their borders were to somehow be breached through the nebulae. Hapes itself is a continental mountain world, most of its green landscapes untouched by technology, as the rulers of the planet revere beauty above all else. Preferring to stay within solitary cities scattered around the planet, the people of Hapes rarely, if ever, grow infrastructure outside of the cities, keeping the planet as one of the most vibrant and beautiful in the galaxy.

high_value_targets.name: The Queen Mother
high_value_targets.title: Hapes Leader
high_value_targets.intel: Despite the Jedi’s destruction of the Lorell Raiders, the Hapes treat them and the Republic with discontent and a wish to stay hidden. The Queen Mother has solidified her stance against the barbarity of man. She is no friend of the Republic or the Separatists. Make sure of the continued neutrality of the Consortium lest they turn their advanced weaponry on the Republic.

Planet.name: Kuat
Planet.description: Kuat is a temperate terrestrial world of large continents between large oceans with many industrial cities and large space ports. Kuat and the Kuat shipyards are the most important Naval facilities in the Republic. Since the dawn of the Republic, Kuat Drive Yards has been the exclusive supplier of many of the Republic’s greatest warships. On the surface there are many important Naval Bases which host a lot of important Republic Naval Officers and Data. There are the space elevators that provide transport to and from the Kuat Drive Yards Orbital Array. The Kuat Drive Yards Orbital Array or just the Orbital Array is where most Republic fleets go to repair and resupply. It unfortunately is more vulnerable to a boarding action than the surface based shipyards that are protected by the Planetary Shields and Planetary Cannons. There are the space elevators that provide transport to and from the Kuat Drive Yards Orbital Array. The Kuat Drive Yards Orbital Array or just the Orbital Array is where most Republic fleets go to repair and resupply. It unfortunately is more vulnerable to a boarding action than the surface based shipyards that are protected by the Planetary Shields and Planetary Cannons.

Planet.name: Trandosha
Planet.description: A rival planet to Kashyyyk, Trandosha is the homeworld of the Trandoshan species. Well known for its deep underground slave network, the planet has become the spawning ground for the Wookie slave trade. Despite this, Trandosha itself has stayed deathly loyal to the Republic, even refusing to join the Sith Empire and the multitude of conflicts within the Republic's early founding. The planet was made up of a majority of forests just like its counterpart; however, unlike Kashyyyk, the planet held a multitude of planes perfect for hunting. A multitude of the galaxy's greatest hunters would use Trandosha as a proving ground, its wildlife proving to be some of the deadliest game in the galaxy.

Planet.name: Mon Cala
Planet.description: The ocean planet of Mon Cala is home to the Mon Calamari and Quarren species. Although being completely covered in ocean, the amphibian people create thriving civilizations under water. However, the proud Quarren people often clash with the Mon Calamari. Also, Mon Cala is famous for its Mon Cal shipyards, being able to produce high quality space faring ships. The seas of Mon Cala thrived with life including thriving sea life and massive coral surrounding cities.

Planet.name: Tatooine
Planet.description: With endless dune seas and two suns, Tatooine is an important world for criminals and nomads alike. Inhabited by moisture farmers, native Tuskans, and species from all reaches of the galaxy. The planet’s isolation in the outer rim provides a haven for crime syndicates like the Hutt Cartel. Hidden within the barren wastelands the Hutt palace houses the leader of the Outer Rim crime operations.

high_value_targets.name: Jabba The Hutt
high_value_targets.title: Crime Lord
high_value_targets.intel: Crime lord of the Outer Rim Hutt operation takes a neutral stand to the Clone Wars. Using the war as a smoke screen to his growing empire.

Planet.name: Coruscant
Planet.description: The Capital of the Galactic Republic, a planet that once was lush and mountainous but has now become an extensive network of thousands of city layers, creating one of the most populous planets in the entire galaxy. It is here that the Senate, the Jedi, and well over 2 trillion people sit comfortably while the war wages elsewhere. Thousands of ships fill its skies, troopers march through the winding streets, and the never-ending cacophony of the bustling planetwide city drowns out any possible threats… even if they are closer than they truly seem.

Planet.name: D'Qar
Planet.description: A verdant planet in the outer rim, this planet used to be home to an unknown civilisation and their ruins span a majority of the planet still. The planet had thick foliage, rolling hills and fields, and a wide variety of species. Likely to contain a few hidden pirate bases or a CIS listening post.

Planet.name: Atollon
Planet.description: Atollon is found in the Outer Rim of the galaxy. The mysterious planet is barely recorded except for its fauna. The dry and rocky terrain is sporadically included with coral tipped trees.

Planet.name: Nar Shaddaa
Planet.description: Nar Shadaa, the capital of smuggling and debauchery, the Hutts have a choke hold on the unfortunate people of this dystopian world. Where there is more spice in people’s system than food and more predatory casinos than grocery stores. There may be clashing gangs all over the dirty cities, but all the wealth trickles upwards towards the Hutts.

Planet.name: Endor
Planet.description: The forest moon of Endor is a mountainous heavily forested moon. Interestingly it also contains vast deserts, smaller oceans, and secluded lakes that cover its surface. The planet is surrounded in massive trees that allow for life to sustain itself above ground level, hiding said life from the elusive Gorax monstrosity that roams the moon's surface.

Planet.name: Duro
Planet.description: Duro is the home world of the Duros but today is a smog covered world with polluted oceans and deserts. The planet itself has some dome cities, and many ancient ruins. However, most Duros live in orbiting Space Stations.

Planet.name: Concordia
Planet.description: Concordia is one of two celestial moons orbiting the planet of Mandalore, and to many within the culture, it was considered the cultural home world of the Mandalorian people. Mountainous terrain, combined with lush and vibrant forests, covered the surface of the moon. For generations, Mandalorian farmers would cultivate their grounds and use their bountiful soil to feed not only the people of Concordia but Mandalore as well. However, not all was prosperous within Concordia, as the nights on the moon would prove deadly to those unprepared for what lurked within. Predators on Concordia are nocturnal and will hunt anything or anyone that finds themselves alone or without protection. Despite this, the moon would prosper for thousands of years, and the Mandalorians would maintain their control against the odds. Yet recently, with the outbreak of the Great Clan Wars, the exiled Clan Vizsla has found itself in charge of the once sacred moon. Violence and forced subjugation have turned many of the farms that once covered the lands into either fortresses or ash.

high_value_targets.name: Pre Vizsla
high_value_targets.title: Governer
high_value_targets.intel: The Governor of Concordia has proclaimed loyalty to Satine Kryze, but Rumors of secret dealings with the Separatists have put his name on lists of people of interest. His Allegiance must be observed.

Planet.name: Utapau
Planet.description: Due to the two key factors of 1.) The Great Hyperspace Disaster and 2.) The Nihil Stormwall, the people of Utupau mostly grew absent from the Republic but has no interest in the War and intends to stay neutral. Combined with food shortages, the Planet’s oceans draining underground into a massive “World Ocean” underground, and the deadly storms that rip across the surface of the planet, most of the population lives in giant sinkholes in one main stable continent. Due to the storms and underground ocean eroding alot of the core of the planet, miles deep sinkholes are formed and these often prove to be the safest places to live. With the massive hyperwind storms plaguing the surface, there is little to no lumber on the planet and all buildings are made from the bones of deceased animals.

Planet.name: Corellia
Planet.description: Corellia is a major Republic shipyard planet as such it is very urban and industrial. With large oceans many of the shipyards are on the ocean. The major sectors of importance are the Port Authority, Shipyard, Cargo, Industrial, and residential sectors. Its shipyards manufacture many ships as well as pilots for the Republic.

high_value_targets.name: Dal Esor
high_value_targets.title: Separatist Leader
high_value_targets.intel: Leader of the local Separatist cell he is hiding somewhere on the planet organizing all CIS activities.

Planet.name: Lothal
Planet.description: Lothal is a world of vast stretches of prairie interspersed by large round rocks sometimes forming mountains, and some seas. In the polar regions these prairies form a tundra and in the equatorial ones they form a savanna. There are few modern cities but for the most part it is rural farmland. Lothal hosts an old abandoned Jedi temple but its only strategic value are its mines as rumors hold they might have Kyber Crystals.

Planet.name: Rodia
Planet.description: Rodia is a swampy jungle planet that is currently starving, the planet's allegiance is to whoever can provide food. The home of the Rodians they live in compact stone cities behind glass or energy walls. Of particular importance is the Senatorial Palace that houses the Rodian Senator.

high_value_targets.name: Nute Gunray
high_value_targets.title: Leader of the Trade Federation
high_value_targets.intel: Supports the Sepratist Alliance with funding and political schemes.

high_value_targets.name: Onaconda Farr
high_value_targets.title: Republic Senator
high_value_targets.intel: Rodian Senator afraid of the war.

Planet.name: Kessel
Planet.description: Kessel’s northern hemisphere is much different than its southern. The north is covered in spice mining run by the Pyke. Whereas the south is densely foliated with lush bush sanctuaries.

Planet.name: Geonosis
Planet.description: Geonosis is the desert home planet of the Geonosians. Its surface is covered in harsh, rocky deserts, marked by mesas and buttes. The native Geonosians live in various hives located on the planet. The largest is the Stalgasin Hive, inhabited by the upper caste. Both its rocks and sky are tinted in shades of red. Beneath the surface, the CIS have constructed major droid foundries that produce tens of thousands of battledroids for the Trade Federation.

campaign_objectives.description: The planet is overrun with droids. Destroy them to turn the tide in this fight.
campaign_objectives.title: Eliminate Battledroids

high_value_targets.name: Sun Fac
high_value_targets.title: Geonosian Leiutenant
high_value_targets.intel: Sun Fac serves as Archduke Poggle the Lesser's chief lieutenant. Our intelligence suggests that all members of the upper caste live in the Stalgasin hive. He is likely to be unarmed, and will attempt to escape if located.

high_value_targets.name: Brood Commander
high_value_targets.title: Geonosian Alpha
high_value_targets.intel: A Geonosian Brood Alpha was the alpha of the Geonosian broods. They earned the position in the hierarchy of their hive after proving his powers as a champion the arena.

high_value_targets.name: Brood Commander
high_value_targets.title: Geonosian Alpha
high_value_targets.intel: A Geonosian Brood Alpha was the alpha of the Geonosian broods. They earned the position in the hierarchy of their hive after proving his powers as a champion the arena.

Planet.conflict_description: Defeat the Separatist droid army before they can escape.

Planet.name: Toydaria
Planet.description: Humid swamps and large forests cover the planet’s surface which is a great environment for the native Toyadarians to make nests. Deep bogs make movement slow and laborious. The dense foliage makes an abundance of blind sides.

Planet.name: Hoth
Planet.description: Hoth is a mostly barren snow-covered planet with frigid and glacier-covered north and south poles. However, while Hoth’s surface is covered in ice and snow, it hides a deep cavernous system of fauna and wildlife below the surface. All of these hidden caves are often used by the animals that live on Hoth as a place of respite from blizzards and the deadly nights on Hoth where the temperature drops below survivable levels. All of this is supported by volcanic activity and geysers found above and within the caves. Lastly, Hoth has a vast array of graveyards, similar to Hypori, that are often mined and salvaged by scavs and corporations for parts or ancient technologies.

Planet.name: Balmorra
Planet.description: Balmorra is a factory planet with lush green plains and spiky black mountains. Its factories are very metallic, modern and sleek. It is an important Techno Union world producing battle droids. This makes it vital to the CIS war machine.

Planet.name: Concord Dawn
Planet.description: Concord Dawn, unlike its cousin in name Concordia, is not actually a moon but a planet within the Mandalore sector. Similar to its parent world of Mandalore, the world is covered in jungles, forests, deserts, mountains, and plains. Similar to Concordia, Concord Dawn would have an agricultural focus to help feed the residents of the Mandalore sector. However, unlike Concordia, which kept a semblance of Mandalorian culture and pride, Concord Dawn tended to be considered an underdeveloped backwater compared to its counterparts. Due to this perception of the planet, it was a primary target of the Death Watch when the Mandalorian Civil War kicked off 58 BBY. Its once vibrant landscapes would be reduced to ash during the war, and years of recultivation have only barely left their mark on attempting to rectify the mistakes of the past. Currently, the planet has found itself under the protection of surviving Journeyman Protectors and True Mandalorians, who seek no involvement in the politics of their New Mandalorian or Clan Vizsla counterparts.

Planet.name: Dathomir
Planet.description: The red planet located in the Outer Rim territories was home to the Zabrak people among dangerous predators and uninviting ecosystems. Constantly shrouded by red mist dwells a mysterious, malevolent aura of the dark side of the Force. While there are multiple witch clans it was also home to rancors. The Nightsisters notably use the intricate caves of Dathomir to freely practice their Magick in solitude.

high_value_targets.name: Mother Talsyn
high_value_targets.title: Leader of the Nightsisters
high_value_targets.intel: No reliable information of her existence to the Republic.

Planet.name: Eriadu
Planet.description: Eriadu is the trade and administrative capital of the Seswenna sector. As such it is a warm smog covered urban world with large savannas, mountains, and oceans serving as wildlife preserves. The Tarkin family was the first of the republic to colonize Eriadu, and have controlled the planet throughout its history. The working conditions on the world are abysmal and there is much public discontent. The Outland Regions Security Force centered on Eriadu has always seemed more than just an outer rim Security Force however, with Wilhuff Tarkin leading them they have become a proper military force in their own right. The Outland Regions Security Force with the onset of war is now officially recognized as part of the Republic Military by the Chancellor himself; thereby forming the 18th sector army.

high_value_targets.name: Cardiff Tarkin
high_value_targets.title: Governor of Eriadu
high_value_targets.intel: Cardiff Tarkin the human cousin of Wilhuff Tarkin is now the most prominent member of the Tarkin family left on Eriadu as Wilhuff Tarkin is currently off world. The acting governor of Eriadu and a prominent member of the ruling Tarkin family he is also the de facto leader of the Outland Regions Security Force.

Planet.name: Scarif
Planet.description: The tropical planet Scarif lies deep in the outer rim on a pivotal hyperspace lane towards the Republic’s flank. Scarif is a world of massive oceans and low level tropical islands. Advanced research facilities holding incredibly classified information are held on Scarif due to its remote nature. Not many inhabit the paradise-like planet providing plenty of space for hidden complexes.

Planet.name: Kamino
Planet.description: Train in the Tipoca City facilities to prepare for combat.

Planet.name: Nal Hutta
Planet.description: Nal Hutta (Glorious Jewel in Huttese), also known simply as Hutta, is controlled by the ancient ruling Hutt families. The planet was originally a lush jungle world with vast oceans, though the Hutts eventually transformed it into a polluted and barren wasteland.

Planet.name: Ryloth
Planet.description: A hot, rocky, and humid planet, Ryloth is the homeworld of the diverse and deadly fauna to which the native Twi’lek species adapted by living in complex cave systems and easily defended settlements. Its terrain varies between lush jungles, rocky deserts, and mesa valleys. Located within CIS-occupied space, the neutral planet serves as an important control point and a heavily defended supply hub for the CIS.

high_value_targets.name: Wat Tambor
high_value_targets.title: Leader of the Techno Union
high_value_targets.intel: Provides key resources to the Separatist Union. Wat Tambor occupies Ryloth’s Ryll refineries, a valuable ore that can be made into medicine or spice.

high_value_targets.name: T-1 Tactical Droid Unit-45721
high_value_targets.title: Droid Commander
high_value_targets.image_url: Commands CIS forces on the ground

high_value_targets.name: T-1 Tactical Droid Unit-64371
high_value_targets.title: Droid Commander
high_value_targets.intel: Occupying a captured local Twi’lek village.

high_value_targets.name: Kelren Narek
high_value_targets.title: Clan Leader
high_value_targets.intel: Clan leader of a faction of Twi’leks. A soldier that wishes for freedom of his people.

Planet.name: Crait
Planet.description: A small, desolate, and uninhabited planet. The Planet is rich in minerals and mainly features salt flats across most of the surface. This made the planet hard to travel as it was often slippery and wind gusts moved around fumes of white salt, revealing the red-colored rhodochrosite underneath. This planet is home to few life, and even fewer features. Located on the surface are several mineral mining and processing stations.

Planet.name: Alderaan
Planet.description: A key core world, and home world of Senator Bail Prestor Organa. Alderaan is known for its natural beauty. Covered in snowy mountain range, and hilly lush green forests. Politically it’s a key core world for the republic, the planet that sits behind an important diplomatic position being in Chancellor Palpatine loyalist committee. The local populace aligns itself with pacifist values, and a big appreciation for culture and art. Regardless of its pacifist ideals it boasts a military more powerful than typical planetary guards.

Planet.name: Kashyyyk
Planet.description: Kashyyyk is one of the most unique and influential planets within the galaxy. Home to the strong and prideful Wookie species, the planet is more of a living entity than a rock. Its forests and fauna are all connected through the Force to the degree that when plants and trees interact with one another via their roots, they will merge and join the hivemind of the planet. This has been both a blessing and a curse to the inhabitants. The forests above Kashyyyk, and even those on the ground level, are relatively safe, with about as much danger as can be found on an almost purely forested planet. However, as soon as you venture too far below the sea level, or you make your way into the cave systems and the fabled Shadowed Lands, you have ventured into territories beyond survival for those unprepared for what awaits in the dark. Due to Kashyyyk's unique connection to the Force, as well as the Wookies' connection to the planet and the Force, the world has created a sort of void within its normally light landscapes. The Dark Side has taken full control of these territories, with ancient evils, monstrosities beyond comprehension, and maddened possessed Wookies who lost themselves to the darkness hiding within.

high_value_targets.name: Chieftain Tarfful
high_value_targets.title: Wookie Leader
high_value_targets.intel: Tarfful is one of the Republic's most loyal and honored allies. Working with his people, he has managed to assist in the manufacturing of weapons and vehicles, as well as assisting with diplomatic relations related to multiple worlds within the Republic. His survival is paramount.

Planet.name: Sullust
Planet.description: Sullust was a barren, obsidian world of lava streams and turquoise lakes. Native fauna such as ash angels foraged during the day and returned to nest at night, while rockrenders prowled the planet's underground. Because the planet's atmosphere was highly toxic, native Sullustans lived in technologically advanced subterranean cities that were highly regarded for their beauty. They commuted to work by lifts and shuttles that carried them to the factories on the planet's surface, alternating between day and night shifts.

Planet.name: Felucia
Planet.description: Felucia could be considered a sister planet to Kashyyyk. It is a world that is symbiotic in nature, as its mushroom-like forests are all interconnected into one large hivemind. Because of this, the planet is very alive and very aware, the Force surrounding it and binding all of the life on Felucia to it. The planet is also extremely violent towards intruders, its fauna being well known to the inhabitants, the local Felucians and Jungle Felucians, but aggressive towards anything foreign. While the Felucians themselves are loyal to the Republic, the Jungle Felucians are far more intertwined with the planet and do its bidding, whether that be Light or Dark. It is a death trap to any army looking to conquer it, as the planet’s very fauna is hostile, sarlac pits and rancors being but a minor issue compared to the poisonous plants and living forests.

Planet.name: Rishi
Planet.description: Rishi is a lush tropical planet with many mountain ranges with massive valleys and scattered swamps. Multiple operational listening sights can be found on Rishi. Confidential information can usually be found in secure facilities.

Planet.name: Christophsis
Planet.description: Christophsis is a crystal-like planet with hexagonally shaped fields and crystal spire trees. In many of these crystal forests were embedded the cities of the Christophsians. Their buildings were high rising towers with many bridges connecting for foot traffic. With a few large and relatively straight roads to connect the different subsections of Christophis, but the people who live here are in a state of rebellion against the CIS. These rebels are being aided by Bail Organa and his own troops.

high_value_targets.name: Trench
high_value_targets.title: Harch Admiral
high_value_targets.intel: The arachnid commander of the invading CIS forces. Highly intelligent and stays in his Capital ship the Invincible.

high_value_targets.name: T-1 Tactical Droid Unit-51283
high_value_targets.title: Droid Commander
high_value_targets.intel: Commands CIS forces on the ground and personally programmed by Admiral Trench.

high_value_targets.name: T-1 Tactical Droid Unit-98342
high_value_targets.title: Droid Commander
high_value_targets.intel: Commands CIS forces on the ground and personally programmed by Admiral Trench.

Planet.name: Mandalore
Planet.description: Mandalore is the ancestral homeworld of the Mandalorians. Once a lush and thriving planet, Mandalore was devastated by the Republic during the Mandalorian wars headed by the once Jedi turned Sith, Revan. Its surface is characterized by ancient deserts and ruins, forcing its populace to live in large City-domes. Under the rulership of the recent Duchess Satine Kryze Mandalore has pursued a doctrine of neutrality, much to the horror of cultural-hardliners such as the Death Watch, who opposed Mandalore's new pacifist ideology.

Planet.name: Mustafar
Planet.description: Mustafar was a young, small planet located in the Mustafar system, within the Atravis sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. Once a garden world nourished by the Bright Star artifact, its orbit was shifted when Lady Corvax unleashed the energies of the Bright Star in an attempt to return her husband to life. The resulting gravimetric duel between the gas giants Jestefad and Lefrani over Mustafar heated the planet's core, transforming the lush world into an imbalanced volcanic hellscape. Mustafar is home to many known and unknown POIs to include a temple shrinking a locus in the dark side of the force, a Jedi Enclave that has gone missing over time, dozens of mining installations for dozens of companies, a Techno Union Headquarters, Droid Factories, hundreds of mining towns, and the main home of the Black Sun Crime Syndicate, and a Separatist Base.

Planet.name: Bespin
Planet.description: Bespin is one of the largest gas giants in the galaxy, and one of the foremost producers of Tibanna gas in the known galaxy. Despite being a gas giant, where the majority of the atmosphere would kill most species based on pressure and temperature alone, there was a zone called the “Bespin Life Zone” that existed 150 to 180 kilometers down from space. This zone was capable of supporting life and would be used by the Incom Corporation to create their original Tibanna gas mining operations and the well-renowned Cloud City. The planet is inhabited by the infamous Tibannuck, a species of flying mynock-like creatures that actively feed off of the gas. Ever since the original bounty against the species was placed during the Old Republic, by the miners guild, the species has recently begun to become endangered.

Planet.name: Naboo
Planet.description: The home world of Senator Amidala, and Chancellor Palpatine, Naboo is a world with a rich resource of plasma and sits on the outskirts of the Mid Rim. This planet has a mix of terrain including Plains, Hills, Swamps, Mountains and cities the most notable city would be Theed. Home to Naboo people and the Gungans they never got along but have joined forces in the fight to keep their planet free. Housing only a small garrison of clone troopers, the majority of the fighting force on Naboo are the local defense forces that the Naboo government hosts.

Planet.name: Yavin Prime
Planet.description: Yavin Prime, also known simply as Yavin, was an orange gas giant, nearly 200,000 kilometers in diameter, located in the Outer Rim Territories Its clouds provided cover in battle, but death awaited any pilot who dove too far.It was orbited by twenty-six moons, three of which could sustain humanoid life, including Yavin 4, Yavin 8, and Yavin 13. One of those moons, Yavin 4, was once home to the ancient Massassi warriors and was used by the Rebel Alliance.

Planet.name: Dagobah
Planet.description: Dagobah was a remote, unexplored planet in the Dagobah system, and one of the purest places in the galaxy within the Force. The planet was hot, humid and a hotbed for all types of life coexisting amongst the swampy forest planet. A location named “The Shelter” is on this planet, home to the descendants of a survey team sent to Dagobah, the Descendants are cult-like and call themselves “The Children”. They are cannibalistic.

GalacticOrder.title: Operation Geonosis
GalacticOrder.description: Secure the Geonosis battlefront and eliminate CIS opposition across key defensive sectors.

phases.name: Phase 1: Orbital Blockade
phases.description: Establish orbital supremacy and eliminate Separatist picket ships.

phases.name: Phase 2: Planetary Landing
phases.description: Deploy LAAT/i gunships and secure primary landing zone at the spire perimeter.

phases.name: Phase 3: Droid Foundry Siege
phases.description: Assault core droid foundries and disable fabrication reactors.

HoloNetArticle.description: With the battle over Geonosis seemingly having no end in sight, and with Dooku still evading capture, a discussion is currently underway within the ranks of the Jedi Masters on Coruscant. With Jedi slowly being assigned as Generals presiding over the Clone Army on Geonosis, a traditionalist within the Order, Jedi Master Rahm Kota, has caused much uproar. Believing Clones to be abominations to the Force, and not truly men nor soldiers, he recently was seen storming out of the Jedi Temple. When approached by the Coruscant Times Kota had this to say, “I can’t believe we are entrusting our future to cloners and their abominations. I will gladly take up the rank of General in this war, but I plan to lead SOLDIERS, REAL MEN AND WOMEN! Not those tank born things”. He then proceeded onto a transport to an unknown destination. -Hagank

HoloNetArticle.description: In the midst of turmoil in our great republic, the traitorous Count Dooku made an address denouncing the Galactic Republic. He did so by taking over a HoloNet relay station in the Raxus System. There are reports of smaller Outer Rim planets to rally even more behind the Separatist alliance. Do not listen to his lies. He wants to spread dissent within our Republic. Stand strong and spread the freedom of our great republic! -Stinger

HoloNetArticle.description: BREAKING: War! The first shots of what is a galactic conflict have been fired on the surface of Geonosis. Multiple Venator-class Star Destroyers and Acclamator-class Assault ships have descended upon the Arkanis Sector, deploying the Republic's newly revealed military force. Now officially designated the Galactic Army of the Republic, the army consists entirely of biological clone soldiers, reported to be among the most highly trained fighters in the galaxy. Citizens have been left stunned, as the Senate never formally approved an official army, yet the deployment carries the full endorsement of Supreme Chancellor Palpatine himself. Clone forces are reported to be actively engaged against Confederacy of Independent Systems forces on the ground, with fighting described as intense. Sources close to the Chancellor's office confirm this action is a direct response to the growing separatist threat. Citizens are urged to remain calm as the situation continues to develop.

HoloNetArticle.description: Recently, Republic representatives to Kamino had met with the facility's lead trainer, a "True Mandalorian" named Kal Skirata. Kaminoan leadership had directed the representatives to Skirata with questions about the Clone Army. Skirata spoke to the officials with fervent support of the Clone Army's readiness for conflict. He had high regard for the efficiency of the army in combat, showing representatives to the Citadel training rooms, even allowing them to meet with some of the highly skilled Alpha ARC Troopers. However, he did have one publicly spoken concern to present to the Republic about the efficiency of Kaminoan tactics. He believed the current structure of the army to be too rigid and recommended a battalion-based structure. Furthermore, he did not trust the Jedi as officers, believing them to be peacekeepers, not soldiers, who did not have the aptitude for war, possibly leading to future casualties. -Hagank
HoloNetArticle.title: Mandalorian Advisor Speaks on Military Readiness

HoloNetArticle.description: Recently, Coruscant Times decided to interview the various factions within Mandalorian culture. What we found was quite shocking. Starting with Mandalore proper, we asked Satine Kryze for a comment on the recent turmoil within the Republic. She condemned the terrorism happening within our borders, and yet also spoke of the need for neutrality on Mandalore's part in these troubling times. Hoping for a more unique perspective, we ventured to speak with Governor Vizsla of Concordia, a subject of the Duchess. What he had to say was shocking, "The barbarity of the Republic is baring its teeth; I am just surprised it took this long to hit the core." Time will tell if Satine shares Vizsla's opinion of the Republic in secret. We went to Concord Dawn to ask the Protectors for their opinions; however, they refused to comment at gunpoint, preferring to stay out of "Republic warmongering and propaganda." -Hagank
HoloNetArticle.title: Mandalorians Divided on Republic Turmoil

HoloNetArticle.description: The Senator of Naboo, Padme Amidala, has come under another attack this night at the hands of a known bounty hunter by the name of Zam Wessell, a shape-shifting Clawdite, who is now confirmed deceased. Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi and Jedi Padawan Anakin Skywalker stopped the attack in the Senator's bedroom where two Kouhuns, venomous creatures from the jungle planet of Indoumodo, were used in an attempt to assassinate the Senator. Luckily, the Jedi were able to save the Senator with mere seconds to spare from a fatal attack. They then pursued the bounty hunter in a high-speed speeder chase all throughout Coruscant to the Outlander Club, an establishment known for gambling located on the lower levels, where the Clawdite used her shape-shifting abilities to hide from the Jedi. Eyewitness accounts from Elan Sel'Sabanago - "I was honestly trying to sell the guy (Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi) some death sticks and then my mind just went blank… next thing I know this guy brings out this light sword and chops off this lady's arm! I'm just thankful he didn't do that to me!" Currently, it's unknown who may have hired the bounty hunter, though the Jedi Order along with Coruscant Security are leading the investigation. This confirms earlier suspicions of an attack on the Senator's diplomatic barge. More to come soon. -Mercy Raccoon
HoloNetArticle.title: Attack on Democracy!

HoloNetArticle.description: As Senator Amidala of Naboo made her landing today, a massive explosion encompassed the landing pad as the J-Type diplomatic Barge was disembarking. The following are confirmed deaths at the scene: two handmaidens by the names of Cordyn and Veersat, and six members of the Royal Naboo Security Forces. Luckily suspecting a possible attack on her life, Captain Gregor Typho had Senator Amidala take a separate N-1 Class Starfighter and disguise herself as her own personal security, leaving her handmaiden in her place. Eyewitness testimony says that the explosions were specifically timed for when possible assassins would have seen the crew disembarking, leaving the possibility of accidents very minimal. Senator Amidala has, as of now, been placed into the protection of the Jedi Council by order of Supreme Chancellor Palpatine. As of now, this is all the information given to news sources, leaving people with many questions. Most importantly, this leaves people wondering what cloak-and-dagger politics are happening behind the scenes. -Mercy Raccoon
HoloNetArticle.title: Tragedy on Coruscant!

HoloNetArticle.description: Earlier this week, protests began to form around the Republic embassy in Choal, the capital of Jabiim. The mining guild has been at a fever pitch of anger ever since one of Jabiim's oldest forests was turned into slag due to Republic mining operations on the planet. The Senate argued that the resources found beneath the forest were well worth the consequences of the invasive mining operations. Tensions boiled over recently as tens of thousands of civilians marched upon the capital. What started as a peaceful protest has quickly turned into violent looting and rioting. When the Senator of Jabiim refused to meet his people, they responded by tearing down the gates of the embassy and storming the courtyard. Republic Judicial Forces have thus far been able to handle the civilians. However, the city itself burned as rumors of Nationalist provocation within the crowd swelled. -Hagank
HoloNetArticle.title: Protests On Jabiim Turn Hostile

HoloNetArticle.description: In an astonishing discovery, Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi has uncovered an ocean world in the far reaches of the galaxy. The newly discovered planet is covered by a vast ocean and battered by raging storms. Initial scans indicate the presence of multiple cities built above the ocean's surface, but further investigation was halted by Republic authorities. The lone Jedi's exploration of Kamino, now officially registered on the Republic Galactic Map, revealed advanced technological facilities. According to Kenobi's report, these installations are operated by the species known as the Kaminoans. Unfortunately, we have not been given the information to what these facilities hold as they have been made classified. This new discovery holds a strange omen for the future. -OakTree
HoloNetArticle.title: Jedi Knight Discovers Mysterious Facility

HoloNetArticle.description: Earlier this week, a shocking disruption of the Galactic status quo occurred on Ansion. Long caught between Separatist and Republic interests, the planet suddenly became a critical linchpin after forming the Keitumite Mutual Military Treaty and Malarian Alliance with seven other worlds. Separatist forces, working through crime lord Hutt Soergg Vosadii Bezhin, sought to exploit old divisions. Their plan was to turn the urbanized “Unity of the Community” peoples against the nomadic Alwari tribes by igniting generations-old border disputes. They hoped this would force the Unity city-states into a defensive pact and ultimately to secede from the Republic, convincing them they would be stronger and better off independent without Republic aid. Fortunately, the Republic received timely Jedi intervention. A joint task force of Barriss Offee, Obi-Wan Kenobi, and Anakin Skywalker worked together to resolve the conflict. By participating in ancient tribal customs and persuading the tribal leaders of the foolishness of planetary war, the Jedi succeeded in ending hostilities. Their efforts impressed the Unity Council, leading to the secession vote being vetoed. Ansion ultimately has chosen to remain within Republic jurisdiction.    - Hagank
HoloNetArticle.title: Galactic Treaties at Threat! Yet Jedi Intervention Prevails

HoloNetArticle.description: Tensions erupted across the world of Kabal this week after widespread food shortages sparked violent riots throughout several population centers. Citizens blame the crisis on the sudden withdrawal of Trade Federation convoys from the region’s vital Trade Corridor routes, a move Federation officials claim was in protest of increased taxation imposed by the Galactic Republic. In a dramatic turn, Count Dooku and Separatist relief vessels arrived shortly after, deploying emergency food supplies directly to starving civilians. Crowds hailed the Confederacy’s intervention as heroic, though Republic officials warn the operation was politically motivated. The unrest quickly escalated into deadly violence as four Jedi peacekeepers and Premiere Jan Dovu were killed attempting to restore order amid the riots. In the aftermath, Kabal’s leadership formally announced its secession from the Republic, marking yet another troubling sign of the galaxy’s deepening divide.   -C.Jester
HoloNetArticle.title: Kabal Descends Into Chaos Amid Secession Crisis

HoloNetArticle.description: Coruscant, Galactic City — The Republic Senate concludes an important conference, revealing a growing unrest among the Core Worlds. Due to the increasing support for the Separatist Alliance throughout the Outer Rim along with more and more planets seceding from the Republic, the Military Creation Act sees a stark increase in support. Senators like Onaconda Farr argue the necessity of the army while senators like Padmé Amidala oppose the act. The war of persuasion rages for hours within the Senate chambers. Discussions and debates consume the Senate building day in and day out as senators talk of the galaxy’s uncertain future. The tension seeping from the Senate into the city itself spreads unease among the people, yet political gridlock persists.  -OakTree
HoloNetArticle.title: Senate Stalls Votes on New Military Creation Act

HoloNetArticle.description: Harnaidan, Muunilinst — The InterGalactic Banking Clan has issued a fresh warning over growing credit instability as the Separatist Crisis continues to unsettle markets across the Republic. In a statement released to major financial hubs, Clan officials pointed to rising uncertainty in Outer Rim trade, political deadlock in the Senate, and weakening confidence among regional lenders as key threats to economic stability. While the Banking Clan called for calm and reaffirmed its commitment to maintaining the flow of capital, critics in the Senate have raised concerns that the galaxy’s most powerful financial institutions may be using the crisis to tighten their influence over already vulnerable systems. As tensions deepen, many now fear that the battle for political control may soon be matched by a struggle over the Republic’s financial lifelines.
HoloNetArticle.title: InterGalactic Banking Clan Warns of Credit Instability Amid Crisis

HoloNetArticle.description: Outer Rim Territories — As the Separatist Crisis deepens and Republic attention remains fixed on Coruscant, the Hutt Cartel has increased its control over key Outer Rim trade routes, citing rising piracy, instability, and lawlessness across neglected frontier systems. Hutt representatives claim the move is necessary to protect commerce and keep vital shipments flowing where local authorities and Republic forces have failed, though critics argue the Cartel is using the crisis to expand its influence under the guise of maintaining order. With tensions rising and central authority stretched thin, many in the Outer Rim now find themselves increasingly dependent on Hutt-controlled networks to preserve trade and security.
HoloNetArticle.title: Hutt Cartel Tightens Control Over Outer Rim Trade Routes

HoloNetArticle.description:
Raxus, Outer Rim — Support for Count Dooku continues to spread across several Outer Rim systems, as frustration with corruption, neglect, and inefficiency in the Galactic Senate fuels growing sympathy for the Separatist cause. Local leaders and citizens alike have voiced increasing concern that the Republic no longer serves the interests of worlds beyond the Core.

Dooku, once a respected Jedi and prominent political figure, has become the face of a movement that promises stronger regional autonomy and freedom from what many see as a decaying and self-serving government on Coruscant. His speeches have resonated particularly strongly in frontier sectors, where trade insecurity, poor infrastructure, and limited Senate attention have long bred resentment.

Republic officials have warned that this rising support threatens galactic stability, while critics argue it reflects deeper failures within the Republic itself. As more systems weigh their loyalties, concern is mounting that political division may soon give way to something far more dangerous.
HoloNetArticle.title: Count Dooku Gains Fresh Support in Outer Rim Systems

HoloNetArticle.description:
Coruscant, Galactic City — The Galactic Senate has once again failed to reach a decision on the deeply divisive Military Creation Act, as debate over the Republic’s future grows more heated by the day. With Separatist tensions continuing to rise across the Outer Rim, supporters of the bill argue that the Republic can no longer rely solely on the Jedi to preserve peace and security.

Opponents, however, warn that authorising a central military would mark a dangerous turning point for the Republic, risking further unrest and pushing more systems into Count Dooku’s growing Separatist movement. Senatorial chambers were filled with fierce exchanges today, with calls for caution, unity, and decisive action echoing across the capital.

As political deadlock continues, many citizens are left wondering how much longer the Republic can endure paralysis in the face of a widening crisis. For now, the fate of the bill — and perhaps the future of the Republic itself — remains uncertain.
HoloNetArticle.title: Senate Deadlocked Again Over Military Creation Act
